## Create BGP Prefix

<a id="opIdip-address-management-prefixes-create-bgp-prefix"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/258def64c72dae45f3e4c8516e2111f2/addressing/prefixes/2af39739cc4e3b5910c918468bb89828/bgp/prefixes \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "cidr": "192.0.2.0/24"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/addressing/prefixes/{prefix_id}/bgp/prefixes`

Create a BGP prefix, controlling the BGP advertisement status of a specific subnet. When created, BGP prefixes are initially withdrawn, and can be advertised with the Update BGP Prefix API.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "cidr": "192.0.2.0/24"
}
```

<h3 id="create-bgp-prefix-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[addressing_account_identifier](#schemaaddressing_account_identifier)|true|none|
|prefix_id|path|[addressing_prefix_identifier](#schemaaddressing_prefix_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|[addressing_bgp_prefix_create](#schemaaddressing_bgp_prefix_create)|true|none|
|» cidr|body|[addressing_cidr](#schemaaddressing_cidr)|true|IP Prefix in Classless Inter-Domain Routing format.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{

  "messages": [],
  "success": true,
  "result": {
    "asn": 13335,

    "auto_advertise_withdraw": true,
    "bgp_signal_opts": {
      "enabled": false,
      "modified_at": "2014-01-01T05:20:00.12345Z"
    },
    "cidr": "192.0.2.0/24",
    "created_at": "2014-01-01T05:20:00.12345Z",
    "id": "7009ba364c7a5760798ceb430e603b74",
    "modified_at": "2014-01-01T05:20:00.12345Z",
    "on_demand": {
      "advertised": true,
      "advertised_modified_at": "2014-01-01T05:20:00.12345Z",
      "on_demand_enabled": true,
      "on_demand_locked": false
    }
  }
}
```

> 4XX Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 7003,
      "message": "No route for the URI"
    }
  ],

  "success": false,
  "result": null
}
```

## Update BGP Prefix

<a id="opIdip-address-management-prefixes-update-bgp-prefix"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/258def64c72dae45f3e4c8516e2111f2/addressing/prefixes/2af39739cc4e3b5910c918468bb89828/bgp/prefixes/7009ba364c7a5760798ceb430e603b74 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "asn_prepend_count": 2,
    "auto_advertise_withdraw": true,
    "on_demand": {
      "advertised": true
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/addressing/prefixes/{prefix_id}/bgp/prefixes/{bgp_prefix_id}`

Update the properties of a BGP Prefix, such as the on demand advertisement status (advertised or withdrawn).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "asn_prepend_count": 2,
  "auto_advertise_withdraw": true,
  "on_demand": {
    "advertised": true
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-bgp-prefix-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[addressing_account_identifier](#schemaaddressing_account_identifier)|true|none|
|prefix_id|path|[addressing_prefix_identifier](#schemaaddressing_prefix_identifier)|true|none|
|bgp_prefix_id|path|[addressing_bgp_prefix_identifier](#schemaaddressing_bgp_prefix_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|[addressing_bgp_prefix_update_advertisement](#schemaaddressing_bgp_prefix_update_advertisement)|true|none|
|» asn_prepend_count|body|[addressing_asn_prepend_count](#schemaaddressing_asn_prepend_count)|false|Number of times to prepend the Cloudflare ASN to the BGP AS-Path attribute|
|» auto_advertise_withdraw|body|[addressing_auto_advertise_withdraw](#schemaaddressing_auto_advertise_withdraw)|false|Determines if Cloudflare advertises a BYOIP BGP prefix even when there is no matching BGP prefix in the Magic routing table. When true, Cloudflare will automatically withdraw the BGP prefix when there are no matching BGP routes, and will resume advertising when there is at least one matching BGP route.|
|» on_demand|body|object|false|none|
|» » advertised|body|boolean|false|none|

> Example responses

```json
      "enabled": false,
      "modified_at": "2014-01-01T05:20:00.12345Z"
    },

    "created_at": "2014-01-01T05:20:00.12345Z",
    "id": "7009ba364c7a5760798ceb430e603b74",
    "modified_at": "2014-01-01T05:20:00.12345Z",
    "on_demand": {
      "advertised": true,
      "advertised_modified_at": "2014-01-01T05:20:00.12345Z",
      "on_demand_enabled": true,
      "on_demand_locked": false
    }
  }
}
```

> 4XX Response

```json
      "code": 7003,
```

<h1 id="cloudflare-api-ip-address-management-service-bindings">IP Address Management Service Bindings</h1>

## List Service Bindings

<a id="opIdip-address-management-service-bindings-list-service-bindings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/258def64c72dae45f3e4c8516e2111f2/addressing/prefixes/2af39739cc4e3b5910c918468bb89828/bindings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/addressing/prefixes/{prefix_id}/bindings`

List the Cloudflare services this prefix is currently bound to. Traffic sent to an address within an IP prefix will be routed to the Cloudflare service of the most-specific Service Binding matching the address.
**Example:** binding `192.0.2.0/24` to Cloudflare Magic Transit and `192.0.2.1/32` to the Cloudflare CDN would route traffic for `192.0.2.1` to the CDN, and traffic for all other IPs in the prefix to Cloudflare Magic Transit.


<h3 id="list-service-bindings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[addressing_account_identifier](#schemaaddressing_account_identifier)|true|none|
|prefix_id|path|[addressing_prefix_identifier](#schemaaddressing_prefix_identifier)|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [],
  "messages": [],
  "success": true,
  "result": [
    {
      "cidr": "192.0.2.0/24",
      "id": "0429b49b6a5155297b78e75a44b09e14",
      "provisioning": {
        "state": "provisioning"
      },
      "service_id": "2db684ee7ca04e159946fd05b99e1bcd",
      "service_name": "Magic Transit"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 4XX Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 7003,
      "message": "No route for the URI"
    }
  ],
  "messages": [],
  "result": null,
  "success": false
}
```

## Create Service Binding

<a id="opIdip-address-management-service-bindings-create-service-binding"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/258def64c72dae45f3e4c8516e2111f2/addressing/prefixes/2af39739cc4e3b5910c918468bb89828/bindings \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "cidr": "192.0.2.0/24",
    "service_id": "2db684ee7ca04e159946fd05b99e1bcd"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/addressing/prefixes/{prefix_id}/bindings`

Creates a new Service Binding, routing traffic to IPs within the given CIDR to a service running on Cloudflare's network.
**NOTE:** The first Service Binding created for an IP Prefix must exactly match the IP Prefix's CIDR. Subsequent Service Bindings may be created with a more-specific CIDR. Refer to the  [Service Bindings Documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/byoip/service-bindings/) for compatibility details.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "cidr": "192.0.2.0/24",
  "service_id": "2db684ee7ca04e159946fd05b99e1bcd"
}
```

<h3 id="create-service-binding-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[addressing_account_identifier](#schemaaddressing_account_identifier)|true|none|
|prefix_id|path|[addressing_prefix_identifier](#schemaaddressing_prefix_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|[addressing_create_binding_request](#schemaaddressing_create_binding_request)|false|none|
|» cidr|body|[addressing_cidr](#schemaaddressing_cidr)|true|IP Prefix in Classless Inter-Domain Routing format.|
|» service_id|body|[addressing_service_identifier](#schemaaddressing_service_identifier)|true|Identifier of a Service on the Cloudflare network. Available services and their IDs may be found in the<br>**List Services** endpoint.<br>|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [],
  "messages": [],
  "success": true,
  "result": {
    "cidr": "192.0.2.0/24",
    "id": "0429b49b6a5155297b78e75a44b09e14",
    "provisioning": {
      "state": "provisioning"
    },
    "service_id": "2db684ee7ca04e159946fd05b99e1bcd",
    "service_name": "Magic Transit"
  }
}
```

> 4XX Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 7003,
      "message": "No route for the URI"
    }
  ],
  "messages": [],
  "result": null,
  "success": false
}
```

## Create Regional Hostname

<a id="opIddls-zone-regional-hostnames-create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/addressing/regional_hostnames \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "hostname": "foo.example.com",
    "region_key": "ca",
    "routing": "dns"
  }'
```

`POST /zones/{zone_id}/addressing/regional_hostnames`

Create a new Regional Hostname entry. Cloudflare will only use data centers that are physically located within the chosen region to decrypt and service HTTPS traffic. Learn more about [Regional Services](https://developers.cloudflare.com/data-localization/regional-services/get-started/).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "hostname": "foo.example.com",
  "region_key": "ca",
  "routing": "dns"
}
```

<h3 id="create-regional-hostname-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|zone_id|path|[dls_identifier](#schemadls_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» hostname|body|[dls_hostname](#schemadls_hostname)|true|DNS hostname to be regionalized, must be a subdomain of the zone. Wildcards are supported for one level, e.g `*.example.com`|
|» region_key|body|[dls_region_key](#schemadls_region_key)|true|Identifying key for the region|
|» routing|body|[dls_routing](#schemadls_routing)|false|Configure which routing method to use for the regional hostname|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [],
  "messages": [],
  "success": true,
  "result": {
    "created_on": {},
    "hostname": "foo.example.com",
    "region_key": "ca",
    "routing": "dns"
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "errors": [

  ],

}
```

## Set auto top-up configuration

<a id="opIdaig-billing-set-topup-config"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/string/ai-gateway/billing/topup/config \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "amount": 5000,
    "threshold": 500
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/billing/topup/config`

Configure auto top-up with a balance threshold and top-up amount. Requests that add a payment method first return authentication details. The configuration is saved only after the authenticated setup is submitted. Dashboard sessions only: API token, OAuth, and service credentials are rejected with 403.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "amount": 5000,
  "threshold": 500
}
```

<h3 id="set-auto-top-up-configuration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|Cloudflare account ID.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» *anyOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» amount|body|integer|true|Auto top-up amount in cents (min 1000).|
|» threshold|body|integer|true|Balance threshold in cents that triggers auto top-up (min 500).|
|» *anyOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» amount|body|integer|true|Auto top-up amount in cents (min 1000).|
|» consent_version|body|string|true|Version of the off-session auto-top-up consent accepted by the user.|
|» payment_method_id|body|string|true|Card to authenticate for future automatic top-ups.|
|» setup_idempotency_key|body|string(uuid)|true|Client-generated UUID that makes payment-method setup safe to retry.|
|» setup_intent_id|body|string|false|Successfully confirmed payment-method setup identifier.|
|» threshold|body|integer|true|Balance threshold in cents that triggers auto top-up (min 500).|

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/billing/topup/eligibility`

Determine whether an account can self-serve a credit top-up, and if not, why. The dashboard forwards the account's payment-method list in the body; the reason logic is owned here.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "payment_methods": [
    {
      "default": true,
      "last_four": "4242",
      "type": "CREDIT_CARD"
    }
  ]
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|Cloudflare account ID.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» payment_methods|body|[object]|false|Account-level payment methods, forwarded by the dashboard.|
|» » default|body|boolean|false|Whether this is the account default payment method.|
|» » last_four|body|string|false|Last 4 digits, for display copy only.|
|» » type|body|string|false|Payment-method type. Absent or unrecognized is treated as non-card (does not error). Known values: PAYPAL, CREDIT_CARD, APPLE_PAY, GOOGLE_PAY, ACH_DIRECT_DEBIT, SEPA_DEBIT, CASHAPP, LINK, CRYPTO.|

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/gateways`

## Delete a gateway

<a id="opIdaig-config-delete-gateway"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/3ebbcb006d4d46d7bb6a8c7f14676cb0/ai-gateway/gateways/my-gateway \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/gateways/{id}`

Permanently deletes an AI Gateway, its configuration, and its stored logs.

<h3 id="delete-a-gateway-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|none|
|id|path|string|true|none|

## List custom domains

<a id="opIdaig-config-list-custom-domain"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/3ebbcb006d4d46d7bb6a8c7f14676cb0/ai-gateway/gateways/my-gateway/custom-domains \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/gateways/{gateway_id}/custom-domains`

Lists the custom domains attached to an AI Gateway, including the certificate and validation status of each domain.

<h3 id="list-custom-domains-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|account_id|path|string|true|none|

|per_page|query|integer|false|none|
|status|query|string|false|none|
|search|query|string|false|none|

|status|pending_dcv|
|status|active|
|status|blocked|
|status|error|

```json
      "modified_at": 1717459200000,
```

## Create a custom domain for a gateway

<a id="opIdaig-config-create-custom-domain"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/3ebbcb006d4d46d7bb6a8c7f14676cb0/ai-gateway/gateways/my-gateway/custom-domains \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "domain": "ai.acme.com",
    "minTLS": "1.0",
    "zone_id": "395566f4c8a5b9d2a5fc0d457b007c44"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/gateways/{gateway_id}/custom-domains`

Provisions a Cloudflare-for-SaaS custom hostname and returns the CNAME target to point DNS at.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "domain": "ai.acme.com",
  "minTLS": "1.0",
  "zone_id": "395566f4c8a5b9d2a5fc0d457b007c44"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-custom-domain-for-a-gateway-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|none|
|gateway_id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» domain|body|string|true|Custom hostname that you own, such as `ai.example.com`.|
|» minTLS|body|string|false|none|
|» zone_id|body|string|true|ID of the Cloudflare zone that contains the custom hostname.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» minTLS|1.0|
|» minTLS|1.1|
|» minTLS|1.2|
|» minTLS|1.3|

```json
  "result": {
    "cname_target": "string",

    "gateway_id": "string",

    "status": "initializing"

  "success": true
}
```

## Create an AI Search instance.

<a id="opIdai-search-create-instance"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/instances \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "ai_gateway_id": "string",
    "ai_search_model": "string",
    "cache": true,
    "cache_threshold": "close_enough",
    "cache_ttl": 172800,
    "chunk": true,
    "chunk_overlap": 10,
    "chunk_size": 64,
    "custom_metadata": [
      {
        "data_type": "text",
        "field_name": "string"
      }
    ],
    "embedding_model": "string",
    "fusion_method": "rrf",
    "hybrid_search_enabled": true,
    "id": "my-ai-search",
    "index_method": {
      "keyword": true,
      "vector": true
    },
    "indexing_options": {
      "keyword_tokenizer": "porter",
      "use_ocr": false
    },
    "max_num_results": 10,
    "metadata": {
      "created_from_aisearch_wizard": true,
      "created_from_emdash_plugin": {
        "type": "native",
        "version": "string"
      },
      "worker_domain": "string"
    },
    "public_endpoint_params": {
      "authorized_hosts": [
        "string"
      ],
      "chat_completions_endpoint": {
        "disabled": false
      },
      "custom_domains": [
        "search.example.com"
      ],
      "default_domain_enabled": true,
      "enabled": false,
      "mcp": {
        "description": "Finds exactly what you'\''re looking for",
        "disabled": false
      },
      "rate_limit": {
        "period_ms": 60000,
        "requests": 1,
        "technique": "fixed"
      },
      "search_endpoint": {
        "disabled": false
      }
    },
    "reranking": false,
    "reranking_model": "string",
    "retrieval_options": {
      "boost_by": [
        {
          "direction": "desc",
          "field": "timestamp"
        }
      ],
      "keyword_match_mode": "and"
    },
    "rewrite_model": "string",
    "rewrite_query": false,
    "score_threshold": 0,
    "source": "string",
    "source_params": {
      "exclude_items": [
        "/admin/**",
        "/private/**",
        "**\\temp\\**"
      ],
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/instances`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Create a new AI Search instance with the given configuration. If type is omitted or null, a non-blank HTTP(S) source infers web-crawler and any other source infers r2; r2 sources must name an existing bucket. A missing or blank source without a type creates a managed upload-only instance.

Deprecated: use /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{namespace}/instances (and descendant paths) instead.

## Get an AI Search instance.

<a id="opIdai-search-fetch-instance"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/instances/my-ai-search \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/instances/{id}`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Retrieve the configuration and status of an AI Search instance.

Deprecated: use /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{namespace}/instances (and descendant paths) instead.

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|none|
|id|path|string|true|none|

## Delete an AI Search instance.

<a id="opIdai-search-delete-instance"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/instances/my-ai-search \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/instances/{id}`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Deletes an AI Search instance and all its indexed data permanently.

Deprecated: use /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{namespace}/instances (and descendant paths) instead.

<h3 id="delete-an-ai-search-instance-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|none|
|id|path|string|true|none|

## Chat Completions

<a id="opIdai-search-instance-chat-completion"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/instances/my-ai-search/chat/completions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "ai_search_options": {
      "cache": {
        "cache_threshold": "super_strict_match",
        "enabled": true
      },
      "custom_metadata": {
        "test": true,
        "user_id": "user-123"
      },
      "query_rewrite": {
        "enabled": true,
        "model": "string",
        "rewrite_prompt": "string"
      },
      "reranking": {
        "enabled": true,
        "match_threshold": 0.4,
        "model": "string"
      },
      "retrieval": {
        "boost_by": [
          {
            "direction": "desc",
            "field": "timestamp"
          }
        ],
        "context_expansion": 0,
        "filters": {},
        "fusion_method": "max",
        "keyword_match_mode": "and",
        "match_threshold": 0,
        "max_num_results": 1,
        "retrieval_type": "vector",
        "return_on_failure": true
      }
    },
    "messages": [
      {
        "content": "string",
        "role": "system"
      }
    ],
    "model": "string",
    "stream": true
  }'
```

## Get instance statistics.

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/instances/my-ai-search/stats \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/instances/{id}/stats`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated

Deprecated: use /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{namespace}/instances (and descendant paths) instead.

|account_id|path|string|true|none|

```bash

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{namespace}/instances`

Lists all AI Search instances in the account.

|order_by|query|string|false|Field to order results by.|
|order_by_direction|query|string|false|Order direction.|

## Create an AI Search instance.

<a id="opIdai-search-namespace-create-instance"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/namespaces/my-namespace/instances \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "ai_gateway_id": "string",
    "ai_search_model": "string",
    "cache": true,
    "cache_threshold": "close_enough",
    "cache_ttl": 172800,
    "chunk": true,
    "chunk_overlap": 10,
    "chunk_size": 64,
    "custom_metadata": [
      {
        "data_type": "text",
        "field_name": "string"
      }
    ],
    "embedding_model": "string",
    "fusion_method": "rrf",
    "hybrid_search_enabled": true,
    "id": "my-ai-search",
    "index_method": {
      "keyword": true,
      "vector": true
    },
    "indexing_options": {
      "keyword_tokenizer": "porter",
      "use_ocr": false
    },
    "max_num_results": 10,
    "metadata": {
      "created_from_aisearch_wizard": true,
      "created_from_emdash_plugin": {
        "type": "native",
        "version": "string"
      },
      "worker_domain": "string"
    },
    "public_endpoint_params": {
      "authorized_hosts": [
        "string"
      ],
      "chat_completions_endpoint": {
        "disabled": false
      },
      "custom_domains": [
        "search.example.com"
      ],
      "default_domain_enabled": true,
      "enabled": false,
      "mcp": {
        "description": "Finds exactly what you'\''re looking for",
        "disabled": false
      },
      "rate_limit": {
        "period_ms": 60000,
        "requests": 1,
        "technique": "fixed"
      },
      "search_endpoint": {
        "disabled": false
      }
    },
    "reranking": false,
    "reranking_model": "string",
    "retrieval_options": {
      "boost_by": [
        {
          "direction": "desc",
          "field": "timestamp"
        }
      ],
      "keyword_match_mode": "and"
    },
    "rewrite_model": "string",
    "rewrite_query": false,
    "score_threshold": 0,
    "source": "string",
    "source_params": {
      "exclude_items": [
        "/admin/**",
        "/private/**",
        "**\\temp\\**"
      ],
      "include_items": [
        "/blog/**",
        "/docs/**/*.html",
        "**\\blog\\**.html"
      ],
      "prefix": "string",
      "r2_jurisdiction": "default",
      "web_crawler": {
        "parse_type": "sitemap"
      }
    },
    "sync_interval": 900,
    "token_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "type": "r2"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{namespace}/instances`

Create a new AI Search instance with the given configuration. If type is omitted or null, a non-blank HTTP(S) source infers web-crawler and any other source infers r2; r2 sources must name an existing bucket. A missing or blank source without a type creates a managed upload-only instance.

## Get an AI Search instance.

<a id="opIdai-search-namespace-fetch-instance"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/namespaces/my-namespace/instances/my-ai-search \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

## Update an AI Search instance.

<a id="opIdai-search-namespace-update-instance"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/namespaces/my-namespace/instances/my-ai-search \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "ai_gateway_id": "string",
    "ai_search_model": "string",
    "cache": true,
    "cache_threshold": "close_enough",
    "cache_ttl": 172800,
    "chunk": true,
    "chunk_overlap": 10,
    "chunk_size": 64,
    "custom_metadata": [
      {
        "data_type": "text",
        "field_name": "string"
      }
    ],
    "embedding_model": "string",
    "fusion_method": "rrf",
    "index_method": {
      "keyword": true,
      "vector": true
    },
    "indexing_options": {
      "keyword_tokenizer": "porter",
      "use_ocr": false
    },
    "max_num_results": 10,
    "metadata": {
      "created_from_aisearch_wizard": true,
      "created_from_emdash_plugin": {
        "type": "native",
        "version": "string"
      },
      "worker_domain": "string"
    },
    "paused": true,
    "public_endpoint_params": {
      "authorized_hosts": [
        "string"
      ],
      "chat_completions_endpoint": {
        "disabled": false
      },
      "custom_domains": [
        "search.example.com"
      ],
      "default_domain_enabled": true,
      "enabled": false,
      "mcp": {
        "description": "Finds exactly what you'\''re looking for",
        "disabled": false
      },
      "rate_limit": {
        "period_ms": 60000,
        "requests": 1,
        "technique": "fixed"
      },
      "search_endpoint": {
        "disabled": false
      }
    },
    "reranking": false,
    "reranking_model": "string",
    "retrieval_options": {
      "boost_by": [
        {
          "direction": "desc",
          "field": "timestamp"
        }
      ],
      "keyword_match_mode": "and"
    },
    "rewrite_model": "string",
    "rewrite_query": false,
    "score_threshold": 0,
    "source": "string",
    "source_params": {
      "exclude_items": [
        "/admin/**",
        "/private/**",
        "**\\temp\\**"
      ],
      "include_items": [
        "/blog/**",
        "/docs/**/*.html",
        "**\\blog\\**.html"
      ],
      "prefix": "string",
      "r2_jurisdiction": "default",
      "web_crawler": {
        "parse_type": "sitemap"
      }
    },
    "summarization": false,
    "summarization_model": "string",
    "sync_interval": 900,
    "system_prompt_ai_search": "string",
    "system_prompt_index_summarization": "string",
    "system_prompt_rewrite_query": "string",
    "token_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  }'
```

## Delete an AI Search instance.

<a id="opIdai-search-namespace-delete-instance"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/namespaces/my-namespace/instances/my-ai-search \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{namespace}/instances/{id}`

Deletes an AI Search instance and all its indexed data permanently.

## Chat Completions

<a id="opIdai-search-namespace-instance-chat-completion"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/namespaces/my-namespace/instances/my-ai-search/chat/completions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "ai_search_options": {
      "cache": {
        "cache_threshold": "super_strict_match",
        "enabled": true
      },
      "custom_metadata": {
        "test": true,
        "user_id": "user-123"
      },
      "query_rewrite": {
        "enabled": true,
        "model": "string",
        "rewrite_prompt": "string"
      },
      "reranking": {
        "enabled": true,
        "match_threshold": 0.4,
        "model": "string"
      },
      "retrieval": {
        "boost_by": [
          {
            "direction": "desc",
            "field": "timestamp"
          }
        ],
        "context_expansion": 0,
        "filters": {},
        "fusion_method": "max",
        "keyword_match_mode": "and",
        "match_threshold": 0,
        "max_num_results": 1,
        "retrieval_type": "vector",
        "return_on_failure": true
      }
    },
    "messages": [
      {
        "content": "string",
        "role": "system"
      }
    ],
    "model": "string",
    "stream": true
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{namespace}/instances/{id}/chat/completions`

Performs a chat completion request against an AI Search instance, using indexed content as context for generating responses.

> Body parameter

```json

  "ai_search_options": {
    "cache": {
      "cache_threshold": "super_strict_match",

    },

      "enabled": true,
```

## Purge search cache.

```bash

  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{namespace}/instances/{id}/purge_cache`

Purges all cached search results for an AI Search instance. A new internal cache key is generated, immediately orphaning all prior cached entries.

|namespace|path|string|true|Namespace name.|

## Move an instance to a different namespace.

<a id="opIdai-search-move-instance"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/namespaces/production/instances/my-blog \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "new_namespace": "staging"
  }'
```

`PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{namespace}/instances/{id}`

Moves an instance from its current namespace to the specified target namespace. Use 'default' with --destination-namespace to move the instance back to the default namespace. Fails with 400 if the target namespace already has an instance with the same id (ids must be unique within a namespace — the same id can exist in different namespaces).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "new_namespace": "staging"
}
```

<h3 id="move-an-instance-to-a-different-namespace-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|none|
|namespace|path|string|true|Current namespace of the instance.|
|id|path|string|true|Instance id.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» new_namespace|body|string|true|Target namespace to move the instance into.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "result": {},
  "success": true
}
```

> 400 Response

```json

  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 0,
      "message": "string"
    }
  ],
  "success": false
}
```

```json
    {

    }

    }
```

`DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{name}`

## Items List.

<a id="opIdai-search-namespace-instance-list-items"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/namespaces/my-namespace/instances/my-ai-search/items \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{namespace}/instances/{id}/items`

Lists indexed items in an AI Search instance.

<h3 id="items-list-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|AI Search instance ID. Lowercase alphanumeric, hyphens, and underscores.|
|account_id|path|string|true|none|
|namespace|path|string|true|Namespace name.|
|page|query|integer|false|none|
|per_page|query|integer|false|none|
|search|query|string|false|none|
|sort_by|query|string|false|Sort order for items. "status" (default) sorts items according to status priority, then last_seen_at. "modified_at" sorts items according to file modification time (most recent first), falling back to created_at.|
|status|query|string|false|none|
|source|query|string|false|Return only items with this source_id. Use "builtin" for uploaded files, or a source identifier like "web-crawler:https://example.com".|
|metadata_filter|query|string|false|JSON-encoded metadata filter using Vectorize filter syntax. Examples: {"folder":"reports/"}, {"timestamp":{"$gte":1700000000000}}, {"folder":{"$in":["docs/","reports/"]}}.|
|item_id|query|string|false|Return only the item with this unique ID. Returns at most one item.|
|key|query|string|false|Return only items with this exact key (object key / filename). Each key is unique within a source, so combine with `source` to disambiguate across data sources.|

## Create or Update Item.

<a id="opIdai-search-namespace-instance-create-or-update-item"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/namespaces/my-namespace/instances/my-ai-search/items \

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "key": "string",
    "next_action": "INDEX",
    "wait_for_completion": false
  }'
```

`PUT /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{namespace}/instances/{id}/items`

Creates or updates an indexed item in an AI Search instance.

> Body parameter

```json

  "key": "string",
  "next_action": "INDEX",
  "wait_for_completion": false
}
```

<h3 id="create-or-update-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|account_id|path|string|true|none|
|namespace|path|string|true|Namespace name.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» key|body|string|true|Item key / filename. Must not exceed 128 characters.|
|» next_action|body|string|true|none|
|» wait_for_completion|body|boolean|false|Wait for indexing before responding. After processing, vector-indexed instances use any time remaining in a 25s wait budget to confirm Vectorize ingestion. Processing itself continues uninterrupted and can exceed that budget. If confirmation times out, the response returns the current item state and background indexing continues. Defaults to false.|

## Upload Item.

<a id="opIdai-search-namespace-instance-upload-item"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/namespaces/my-namespace/instances/my-ai-search/items \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F 'file=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'metadata=string' \
  -F 'wait_for_completion=false'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{namespace}/instances/{id}/items`

Uploads a file to a managed AI Search instance via multipart/form-data.

> Body parameter

```yaml
metadata: string
wait_for_completion: false
```

|» metadata|body|string|false|JSON string of custom metadata key-value pairs.|
|» wait_for_completion|body|boolean|false|Wait for indexing before responding. After processing, vector-indexed instances use any time remaining in a 25s wait budget to confirm Vectorize ingestion.     "wait_for_completion": false
```bash
  }'
```

`PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{namespace}/instances/{id}/items/{item_id}`

|body|body|object|false|none|
|» next_action|body|string|true|none|
|» wait_for_completion|body|boolean|false|Wait for indexing before responding. After processing, vector-indexed instances use any time remaining in a 25s wait budget to confirm Vectorize ingestion. Processing itself continues uninterrupted and can exceed that budget. If confirmation times out, the response returns the current item state and background indexing continues. Defaults to false.|

## Multi-Instance Chat Completions

<a id="opIdai-search-namespace-multi-instance-chat-completion"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/namespaces/my-namespace/chat/completions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "ai_search_options": {
      "cache": {
        "cache_threshold": "super_strict_match",
        "enabled": true
      },
      "custom_metadata": {
        "test": true,
        "user_id": "user-123"
      },
      "instance_ids": [
        "my-ai-search"
      ],
      "query_rewrite": {
        "enabled": true,
        "model": "string",
        "rewrite_prompt": "string"
      },
      "reranking": {
        "enabled": true,
        "match_threshold": 0.4,
        "model": "string"
      },
      "retrieval": {
        "boost_by": [
          {
            "direction": "desc",
            "field": "timestamp"
          }
        ],
        "context_expansion": 0,
        "filters": {},
        "fusion_method": "max",
        "keyword_match_mode": "and",
        "match_threshold": 0,
        "max_num_results": 1,
        "retrieval_type": "vector",
        "return_on_failure": true
      }
    },
    "messages": [
      {
        "content": "string",
        "role": "system"
      }
    ],
    "model": "string",
    "stream": true
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{name}/chat/completions`

Performs a chat completion request against multiple AI Search instances in parallel, merging retrieved content as context for generating a response.

```json
      "model": "string",
      "rewrite_prompt": "string"

      "model": "string"
    },
    "retrieval": {
      "boost_by": [
        {
          "direction": "desc",

        }
      ],
```

## Multi-Instance Search

<a id="opIdai-search-namespace-multi-instance-search"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/c3dc5f0b34a14ff8e1b3ec04895e1b22/ai-search/namespaces/my-namespace/search \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "ai_search_options": {
      "cache": {
        "cache_threshold": "super_strict_match",
        "enabled": true
      },
      "custom_metadata": {
        "test": true,
        "user_id": "user-123"
      },
      "instance_ids": [
        "my-ai-search"
      ],
      "query_rewrite": {
        "enabled": true,
        "model": "string",
        "rewrite_prompt": "string"
      },
      "reranking": {
        "enabled": true,
        "match_threshold": 0.4,
        "model": "string"
      },
      "retrieval": {
        "boost_by": [
          {
            "direction": "desc",
            "field": "timestamp"
          }
        ],
        "context_expansion": 0,
        "filters": {},
        "fusion_method": "max",
        "keyword_match_mode": "and",
        "match_threshold": 0,
        "max_num_results": 1,
        "retrieval_type": "vector",
        "return_on_failure": true
      }
    },
    "messages": [
      {
        "content": "string",
        "role": "system"
      }
    ],
    "query": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-search/namespaces/{name}/search`

Performs a semantic search query against multiple AI Search instances in parallel, merging the retrieved results into a single ranked response.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "ai_search_options": {
    "cache": {
      "cache_threshold": "super_strict_match",
      "enabled": true
    },
    "custom_metadata": {
      "test": true,
      "user_id": "user-123"
    },
    "instance_ids": [
      "my-ai-search"
    ],
    "query_rewrite": {
      "enabled": true,
      "model": "string",
      "rewrite_prompt": "string"
    },
    "reranking": {
      "enabled": true,
      "match_threshold": 0.4,
      "model": "string"
    },
    "retrieval": {
      "boost_by": [
        {
          "direction": "desc",
          "field": "timestamp"
        }
      ],
      "context_expansion": 0,
      "filters": {},
      "fusion_method": "max",
      "keyword_match_mode": "and",
      "match_threshold": 0,
      "max_num_results": 1,
      "retrieval_type": "vector",
      "return_on_failure": true
    }
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "content": "string",
      "role": "system"
    }
  ],
  "query": "string"
}
```

## Run an AI model with request options

<a id="opIdworkers-ai-post-run-generic"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/ai/run \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "input": {
      "prompt": "Tell me a joke"
    },
    "model": "openai/gpt-5.5",
    "options": {
      "extraHeaders": {
        "property1": "string",
        "property2": "string"
      },
      "gateway": {
        "cacheTtl": 3600,
        "id": "my-gateway",
        "skipCache": true
      }
    }
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai/run`

Runs an AI model using a JSON body containing model, input, and optional options fields. Unlike the model-specific URL endpoint, this endpoint takes the model identifier in the body and nests the model's inputs under input.

Use options.extraHeaders to pass additional provider headers. Accepts Workers AI model identifiers and AI Gateway provider model identifiers.

See the [Workers AI model catalog](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/) for Workers AI model inputs, or the provider's documentation for models accessed through AI Gateway.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "input": {
    "prompt": "Tell me a joke"
  },
  "model": "openai/gpt-5.5",
  "options": {
    "extraHeaders": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    },
    "gateway": {
      "cacheTtl": 3600,
      "id": "my-gateway",
      "skipCache": true
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="run-an-ai-model-with-request-options-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» input|body|object|true|JSON object containing the selected model's input fields, such as prompt or messages. Do not include model or options inside this object.|
|» model|body|string|true|The AI model to execute (e.g., @cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it, openai/gpt-5.5, anthropic/claude-opus-4.7)|
|» options|body|object|false|none|
|» » extraHeaders|body|object|false|Additional headers to pass to the AI provider|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» » gateway|body|object|false|none|
|» » » cacheTtl|body|number|false|Cache TTL in seconds|
|» » » id|body|string|false|AI Gateway ID for caching and logging|
|» » » skipCache|body|boolean|false|Skip cache lookup for this request|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {}
  ],
  "messages": [
    {}
  ],
  "result": {},
  "success": true
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 0,
      "message": "string"
    }
  ],
  "success": true
}
```

<h3 id="run-an-ai-model-with-request-options-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Model response|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request - missing required fields or invalid input|Inline|

<h3 id="run-an-ai-model-with-request-options-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|errors|[object]|true|none|none|
|messages|[object]|true|none|none|
|result|object|true|none|Model-specific output. Format varies by model type.|
|success|boolean|true|none|none|

## Run a Workers AI model

<a id="opIdworkers-ai-post-run-model"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/ai/run/%40cf%2Fmeta%2Fllama-3.1-8b-instruct \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "text": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai/run/{model_name}`

Runs the Workers AI model specified in the URL path. Send the model's inputs directly in the request body, without a model/input/options wrapper.

Accepts model-specific JSON or binary input. The response format depends on the model and the requested output.

See the [model catalog](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/) for supported models and their input formats.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "text": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="run-a-workers-ai-model-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|Cloudflare account ID used for this AI model request.|
|model_name|path|string|true|Workers AI model identifier, including its namespace and model name.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» text|body|string|true|The text that you want to classify|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» guidance|body|number|false|Controls how closely the generated image should adhere to the prompt; higher values make the image more aligned with the prompt|
|» height|body|integer|false|The height of the generated image in pixels|
|» image|body|[number]|false|For use with img2img tasks. An array of integers that represent the image data constrained to 8-bit unsigned integer values|
|» image_b64|body|string|false|For use with img2img tasks. A base64-encoded string of the input image|
|» mask|body|[number]|false|An array representing An array of integers that represent mask image data for inpainting constrained to 8-bit unsigned integer values|
|» negative_prompt|body|string|false|Text describing elements to avoid in the generated image|
|» num_steps|body|integer|false|The number of diffusion steps; higher values can improve quality but take longer|
|» prompt|body|string|true|A text description of the image you want to generate|

## Convert uploaded files to Markdown

<a id="opIdworkers-ai-post-to-markdown"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/ai/tomarkdown \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F 'files=["string"]'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai/tomarkdown`

Converts files uploaded as multipart form data into Markdown using Workers AI. Returns a conversion result for each file. Use the supported-formats endpoint to check accepted file types.

> Body parameter

```yaml
files:
  - string
```

<h3 id="convert-uploaded-files-to-markdown-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» files|body|[string(binary)]|true|Files to convert, supplied as multipart file uploads.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "result": [
    {
      "data": "string",
      "format": "string",
      "mimeType": "string",
      "name": "string",
      "tokens": "string"
    }
  ],
  "success": true
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "message": "string"
    }
  ],
  "result": {},
  "success": false
}
```

## Query analytics timeseries

<a id="opIdart-analytics-query-timeseries"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/analytics/query/shadow_it/timeseries \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "filters": [
      {
        "name": "allowed",
        "op": "eq",
        "values": [
          true
        ]
      }
    ],
    "from": "2024-11-01T00:00:00Z",
    "groupBy": [
      "country",
      "allowed"
    ],
    "resolution": "day",
    "stats": [
      "attemptsTotal"
    ],
    "to": "2024-11-08T00:00:00Z"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/analytics/query/{dataset}/timeseries`

Returns time-bucketed analytics data for a dataset. Includes time slots, each containing the requested stats, group-by dimensions, and resolution-controlled bucket size (e.g. `hour`, `day`).


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "filters": [
    {
      "name": "allowed",
      "op": "eq",
      "values": [
        true
      ]
    }
  ],
  "from": "2024-11-01T00:00:00Z",
  "groupBy": [
    "country",
    "allowed"
  ],
  "resolution": "day",
  "stats": [
    "attemptsTotal"
  ],
  "to": "2024-11-08T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<h3 id="query-analytics-timeseries-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|Cloudflare account identifier.|
|dataset|path|string|true|Dataset name to query. Examples: `access-logins`, `gateway-http`, `gateway-dns`, `gateway-http`, `shadow-it`.<br>|
|body|body|[art_QueryTimeseries](#schemaart_querytimeseries)|true|none|
|» filters|body|[[art_Filter](#schemaart_filter)]|true|Filters to apply before aggregating results.|
|» from|body|string(date-time)|true|The start of the query time range (inclusive). RFC3339 format with timezone is required (e.g. `2024-11-05T00:00:00Z`).|
|» groupBy|body|[string]|true|Specifies the column names to group results by. Requires valid columns for the target dataset.|
|» stats|body|[string]|true|Specifies the stat names to include in results. Requires valid stats for the target dataset (e.g. `attemptsTotal`, `bytesTotal`).|
|» to|body|string(date-time)|true|Specifies the end of the query time range (exclusive). Requires RFC3339 format with timezone.|
|» resolution|body|string|true|Time bucket size for grouping results. Controls the granularity of the returned time slots.<br>|

<h1 id="cloudflare-api-analytics-sql">Analytics SQL</h1>

## Query analytics datasets

<a id="opIdsql-api-query-get-account-scoped"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef/analytics/sql?query=SELECT%20edgeResponseStatus%20FROM%20events.httpRequests%20WHERE%20datetime%20%3E%20'\''2026-01-01'\''%20LIMIT%2010' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/analytics/sql`

Executes a SQL query scoped to the account in the request path. API Gateway preserves the account path, and SQL API requires it to match the signed JWT account, so an accountTag predicate or JSON scope is not required. Explicit account scope must match the path account. Any zone restrictions must belong to that account. Query parameters, time ranges, output formats, authorization, and responses follow the legacy query endpoint.

<h3 id="query-analytics-datasets-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|Account that authorizes and scopes the request.|
|query|query|string|true|SQL query to execute. A trailing FORMAT selects JSON, JSONEachRow, TabSeparated, or TSV output on any dataset.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {}
  ],
  "rows": 0,
  "statistics": {
    "bytes_read": 0,
    "elapsed_ms": 0,
    "rows_read": 0
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "error_chain": [
    {}
  ],
  "message": "string"
}
```

> 403 Response

```text
Authorization error
```

<h3 id="query-analytics-datasets-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Query executed successfully. Columns that the query reaches only through `*` exclude any that the caller is not permitted to read. ClickHouse's default JSON envelope has data, rows, and statistics; explicit FORMAT JSON additionally has typed metadata and rows_before_limit_at_least. Log Explorer's default and FORMAT JSON responses use its existing {data, rows} envelope, without unavailable metadata, pre-limit counts, or statistics. FORMAT JSONEachRow returns newline-delimited JSON objects. FORMAT TabSeparated and TSV return escaped tab-separated rows without a header; Log Explorer serializes nested JSON values as compact JSON text in one field.<br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|The request is malformed, or authentication was rejected by the API gateway before the request reached the SQL service.<br>|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|Authentication failed, the caller is not authorized, or the query references a column the caller is not permitted to read.<br>|Inline|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|The SQL query or its parameters are invalid, including invalid function arguments.|Inline|
|429|Too Many Requests|The query exceeded a resource or request-rate limit.|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|An internal error occurred.|Inline|
|501|Not Implemented|The query uses a SQL feature that is not implemented.|Inline|
|503|Service Unavailable|A required service is temporarily unavailable.|Inline|
|507|Insufficient Storage|The query exhausted available resources.|Inline|

<h3 id="query-analytics-datasets-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|[analytics-sql_SqlQueryResponse](#schemaanalytics-sql_sqlqueryresponse)|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|[analytics-sql_ClickHouseJsonQueryResponse](#schemaanalytics-sql_clickhousejsonqueryresponse)|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|[analytics-sql_LogExplorerQueryResponse](#schemaanalytics-sql_logexplorerqueryresponse)|false|none|none|

Status Code **400**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|[analytics-sql_ApiErrorResponse](#schemaanalytics-sql_apierrorresponse)|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|[analytics-sql_GatewayApiErrorResponse](#schemaanalytics-sql_gatewayapierrorresponse)|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|Retry-After|integer|int64|Seconds to wait before retrying. Present when the account request rate limit is exceeded; omitted for query resource limits.<br>|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_token

## List available analytics datasets

<a id="opIdsql-api-introspection-account-scoped"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef/analytics/sql/introspection \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/analytics/sql/introspection`

Returns the dataset catalogue for the account in the request path. API Gateway preserves the account path, and SQL API requires it to match the signed JWT account; account_tag is not required as a query parameter. If supplied, it must match the path account. Dataset and column discovery options are identical to the legacy introspection endpoint.

<h3 id="list-available-analytics-datasets-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|Account that authorizes and scopes the request.|
|include_columns|query|boolean|false|Include column metadata for each returned dataset.|
|include_custom_attributes|query|boolean|false|Include a capped set of custom attribute names and types observed during the preceding seven days, as `custom_attributes`. Requires a nonempty dataset_name. Deprecated in favor of `include_attributes`.<br>|
|include_attributes|query|boolean|false|Include a capped set of attribute names and types observed during the preceding seven days, as `attributes`. Requires a nonempty dataset_name. Replaces `include_custom_attributes`, which is deprecated.<br>|
|include_wae|query|boolean|false|Include Workers Analytics Engine datasets, which are discovered from the account's own data. Set to `false` to return only datasets described from the static catalogue, which avoids that lookup.<br>|
|include_lex|query|boolean|false|Include Log Explorer datasets, which are listed only where the account has them. Set to `false` to return only datasets described from the static catalogue, which avoids that lookup.<br>|
|dataset_name|query|string|false|Return only the dataset with this exact name. An empty value is treated as if the parameter had been omitted, and does not filter the catalogue. A name that matches no dataset in this deployment's catalogue is rejected with `422`; a dataset that exists but is not describable here is rejected identically, so the two cases cannot be told apart.<br><br>A Workers Analytics Engine dataset is named in full, as `events.analyticsEngine.<dataset_name>`; the namespace on its own returns every such dataset the account has. A `dataset_name` the account does not have is rejected with `422` like any other unknown name.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "datasets": [
    {
      "attributes": [
        {
          "data_type": "String",
          "name": "string"
        }
      ],
      "category": "HTTP Traffic",
      "columns": [
        {
          "data_type": "String",
          "description": "string",
          "hidden": true,
          "name": "clientRequestPath"
        }
      ],
      "custom_attributes": [
        {
          "data_type": "String",
          "name": "string"
        }
      ],
      "description": "string",
      "hidden": true,
      "kind": {
        "availability": [
          {
            "scope": "account",
            "zone": "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
          }
        ],
        "events": {
          "sampling": "unsampled"
        },
        "logs": {
          "sampling": "unsampled"
        },
        "states": {
          "sampling": "unsampled",
          "valid_aggregations": [
            "count",
            "max"
          ]
        }
      },
      "name": "events.httpRequests",
      "title": "HTTP Requests"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "error_chain": [
    {}
  ],
  "message": "string"
}
```

> 403 Response

```text
Authorization error
```

> 422 Response


## List available analytics datasets

<a id="opIdsql-api-introspection"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/analytics/sql/introspection?account_tag=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /analytics/sql/introspection`

Returns the analytics dataset catalogue. By default, the response contains dataset names, titles, categories, descriptions, kinds, and hidden flags. Set `include_columns` to include each dataset's column names, descriptions, data types, and hidden flags. The caller must have Account Analytics Read permission on the account identified by `account_tag`. Dataset names, descriptions, and columns are the same for every authorized account. When `include_custom_attributes` or `include_attributes` is set, the response also includes attribute names and types discovered from that account's own data, which legitimately differs per caller. `attributes` is a replacement for `custom_attributes` that will eventually be removed; until then, set either flag independently to receive the corresponding field. `hidden` marks catalogue entries a client should de-emphasise. It has no effect on access: hidden datasets and columns are returned here and remain fully queryable.

The catalogue lists the datasets this deployment is able to describe, which is not a fixed list. Some datasets are described by the service that owns them and are listed only where that service is available, so the same account may see a different catalogue in different environments, and datasets may appear or disappear without a change to this API. Clients should query the catalogue rather than hard-coding it, and should not treat a dataset's absence as proof that it does not exist.

Workers Analytics Engine datasets are named by the account that writes them, so they are discovered from that account's own data rather than from a fixed list. They appear as `events.analyticsEngine.<dataset_name>` and differ per account. A dataset is listed for as long as any of its data is retained, so it does not disappear from the catalogue merely because writes have stopped. An account with a very large number of datasets may receive a truncated list. Set `include_wae=false` to omit them.

Log Explorer datasets are listed only where the account has them, so they differ per account and are not part of the static catalogue. Set `include_lex=false` to omit them.


<h3 id="list-available-analytics-datasets-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_tag|query|string|true|Account whose available analytics datasets are returned.|
|include_columns|query|boolean|false|Include column metadata for each returned dataset.|
|include_custom_attributes|query|boolean|false|Include a capped set of custom attribute names and types observed during the preceding seven days, as `custom_attributes`. Requires a nonempty dataset_name. Deprecated in favor of `include_attributes`.<br>|
|include_attributes|query|boolean|false|Include a capped set of attribute names and types observed during the preceding seven days, as `attributes`. Requires a nonempty dataset_name. Replaces `include_custom_attributes`, which is deprecated.<br>|
|include_wae|query|boolean|false|Include Workers Analytics Engine datasets, which are discovered from the account's own data. Set to `false` to return only datasets described from the static catalogue, which avoids that lookup.<br>|
|include_lex|query|boolean|false|Include Log Explorer datasets, which are listed only where the account has them. Set to `false` to return only datasets described from the static catalogue, which avoids that lookup.<br>|
|dataset_name|query|string|false|Return only the dataset with this exact name. An empty value is treated as if the parameter had been omitted, and does not filter the catalogue. A name that matches no dataset in this deployment's catalogue is rejected with `422`; a dataset that exists but is not describable here is rejected identically, so the two cases cannot be told apart.<br><br>A Workers Analytics Engine dataset is named in full, as `events.analyticsEngine.<dataset_name>`; the namespace on its own returns every such dataset the account has. A `dataset_name` the account does not have is rejected with `422` like any other unknown name.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "datasets": [
    {
      "attributes": [
        {
          "data_type": "String",
          "name": "string"
        }
      ],
      "category": "HTTP Traffic",
      "columns": [
        {
          "data_type": "String",
          "description": "string",
          "hidden": true,
          "name": "clientRequestPath"
        }
      ],
      "custom_attributes": [
        {
          "data_type": "String",
          "name": "string"
        }
      ],
      "description": "string",
      "hidden": true,
      "kind": {
        "availability": [
          {
            "scope": "account",
            "zone": "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
          }
        ],
        "events": {
          "sampling": "unsampled"
        },
        "logs": {
          "sampling": "unsampled"
        },
        "states": {
          "sampling": "unsampled",
          "valid_aggregations": [
            "count",
            "max"
          ]
        }
      },
      "name": "events.httpRequests",
      "title": "HTTP Requests"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "error_chain": [
    {}
  ],
  "message": "string"
}
```

> 403 Response

```text
Authorization error
```

> 422 Response

```text
Input was invalid: There are no introspectable datasets matching the provided criteria (dataset_name=`events.nonexistent`)
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Dataset catalogue returned successfully.|[analytics-sql_IntrospectionResponse](#schemaanalytics-sql_introspectionresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|The request is malformed, or authentication was rejected by the API gateway before the request reached the SQL service.<br>|Inline|

The message names the criteria that matched nothing.<br>|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|An internal error occurred.|Inline|

## Execute an Analytics Engine SQL query via query parameter

<a id="opIdanalytics-engine-sql-query-get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/analytics_engine/sql?query=SELECT%20blob1%2C%20count()%20FROM%20my_dataset%20WHERE%20timestamp%20%3E%20NOW()%20-%20INTERVAL%20'\''1'\''%20DAY%20GROUP%20BY%20blob1%20ORDER%20BY%20count()%20DESC%20LIMIT%2010' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/analytics_engine/sql`

Executes a SQL query against Workers Analytics Engine data. Pass the SQL query as a query parameter. The response uses newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) by default, or a single JSON object when the query includes a FORMAT JSON clause. Use the POST method for longer queries that may exceed URL length limits.

<h3 id="execute-an-analytics-engine-sql-query-via-query-parameter-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|query|query|string|true|Supply a SQL query to run against your Analytics Engine datasets. Use only SELECT statements. The service validates the query against a restricted SQL grammar before execution.|
|account_id|path|string|true|Cloudflare account identifier.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "blob1": "US",
      "count()": 1523
    },
    {
      "blob1": "DE",
      "count()": 847
    }
  ],
  "meta": [
    {
      "name": "blob1",
      "type": "String"
    },
    {
      "name": "count()",
      "type": "UInt64"
    }
  ],
  "rows": 2
}
```

> 400 Response

```text
Content type error
```

> 403 Response

```text
Authorization error
```

> 422 Response

```text
Input was invalid: syntax error at position 15
```

> 429 Response

```text
Resource limit: Your query requires too much memory. Try simplifying the query or narrowing the time range.
```

> 500 Response

```text
Sorry, we were unable to evaluate your query. Please try again later.
```

> 503 Response

```text
Query timed out waiting in queue. The system is under heavy load. Please try again later.
```

> 504 Response

```text
Gateway Timeout
```

<h3 id="execute-an-analytics-engine-sql-query-via-query-parameter-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Query executed successfully. Results are returned as newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) by default. Each line is a JSON object representing one row of results. If the FORMAT JSON clause is used in the query, the response is a single JSON object with data, meta, and rows fields.<br>|[analytics-engine_JsonFormatResponse](#schemaanalytics-engine_jsonformatresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request. The query parameter or request body is missing or malformed.<br>|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden. Authentication failed, the account does not have access to Analytics Engine, or the provided token does not have the required permissions. This service returns 403 for all authentication and authorization failures (missing token, invalid token, audience mismatch, account mismatch, or insufficient entitlements).<br>|Inline|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable Entity. The SQL query failed validation. Common causes include syntax errors, references to unknown columns, unsupported SQL features (JOINs, non-SELECT statements), type mismatches in expressions, and GROUP BY violations.<br>|Inline|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too Many Requests. The account has exceeded the concurrent query limit, the global query pool is full, or a resource limit was hit (query too slow, too much memory, result too large).<br>|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal Server Error. An unexpected error occurred during query execution. This may indicate a transient backend issue. Retrying the request after a brief delay is recommended.<br>|Inline|
|503|Service Unavailable|Service Unavailable. The query queue wait timeout expired before a processing slot became available. This occurs under heavy load when per-account or global concurrency limits are saturated. Retry the request after a brief delay.<br>|Inline|
|504|Gateway Timeout|Gateway Timeout. The query exceeded the 60-second execution timeout. Simplify the query, narrow the time range, or add more restrictive filters to reduce execution time.<br>|Inline|

|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable Entity. The SQL query failed validation. Common causes include syntax errors, references to unknown columns, unsupported SQL features (JOINs, non-SELECT statements), type mismatches in expressions, and GROUP BY violations.<br>|Inline|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too Many Requests. The account has exceeded the concurrent query limit, the global query pool is full, or a resource limit was hit (query too slow, too much memory, result too large).<br>|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal Server Error. An unexpected error occurred during query execution. This may indicate a transient backend issue. Retrying the request after a brief delay is recommended.<br>|Inline|
|503|Service Unavailable|Service Unavailable. The query queue wait timeout expired before a processing slot became available. This occurs under heavy load when per-account or global concurrency limits are saturated. Retry the request after a brief delay.<br>|Inline|
|504|Gateway Timeout|Gateway Timeout. The query exceeded the 60-second execution timeout. Simplify the query, narrow the time range, or add more restrictive filters to reduce execution time.<br>|Inline|

## Create a repository

<a id="opIdartifacts_repos_create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/string/artifacts/namespaces/string/repos \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "default_branch": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "read_only": true
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos`

> Body parameter

```json
}
```

## Delete a repository

<a id="opIdartifacts_repos_delete"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/string/artifacts/namespaces/string/repos/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}`

Deletes a repository and schedules cleanup of its backing data.

<h3 id="delete-a-repository-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|name|path|string|true|Repository name.|
|account_id|path|string|true|Cloudflare account ID.|

## Read a Git blob

<a id="opIdartifacts_repos_blob_get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/string/artifacts/namespaces/string/repos/string/blob/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/blob/{hash}`

Returns raw bytes for an immutable Git blob object. Blob responses are cacheable forever by hash.

<h3 id="read-a-git-blob-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|Artifacts namespace name.|
|name|path|string|true|Repository name.|
|hash|path|string|true|40-character lowercase hexadecimal Git object hash.|
|account_id|path|string|true|Cloudflare account ID.|

## Read a Git commit

<a id="opIdartifacts_repos_commit_get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/string/artifacts/namespaces/string/repos/string/commit/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/commit/{hash}`

Returns decoded metadata for an immutable Git commit object. Commit responses are cacheable forever by hash.

<h3 id="read-a-git-commit-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|Artifacts namespace name.|
|name|path|string|true|Repository name.|
|hash|path|string|true|40-character lowercase hexadecimal Git object hash.|
|account_id|path|string|true|Cloudflare account ID.|

## Fork a repository

<a id="opIdartifacts_repos_fork"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/string/artifacts/namespaces/string/repos/string/fork \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "default_branch_only": true,
    "description": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "read_only": true
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/fork`

> Body parameter

## Import a repository

<a id="opIdartifacts_repos_import"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/string/artifacts/namespaces/string/repos/string/import \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "branch": "string",
    "depth": 1,
    "read_only": true,
    "url": "http://example.com"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/import`

Imports an HTTPS Git repository into an Artifacts repository.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "branch": "string",
  "depth": 1,
  "read_only": true,
  "url": "http://example.com"
}
```

<h3 id="import-a-repository-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|Artifacts namespace name.|
|name|path|string|true|Repository name.|
|account_id|path|string|true|Cloudflare account ID.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» branch|body|string|false|Git branch name. Must match /^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._/-]*$/, must not contain '..', and must not end with '/' or '.'.|
|» depth|body|integer|false|none|
|» read_only|body|boolean|false|none|
|» url|body|string(uri)|true|none|

## Read commit history

<a id="opIdartifacts_repos_log_get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/string/artifacts/namespaces/string/repos/string/log \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/log`

Returns commit metadata walking backwards from a ref, branch, tag, or HEAD.

<h3 id="read-commit-history-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|Artifacts namespace name.|
|name|path|string|true|Repository name.|
|ref|query|string|false|Git ref, branch, tag, or commit hash. Defaults to HEAD.|
|limit|query|integer|false|none|
|offset|query|integer|false|none|
|account_id|path|string|true|Cloudflare account ID.|

## Read a raw file with content type

<a id="opIdartifacts_repos_raw_get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/string/artifacts/namespaces/string/repos/string/raw/string/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/raw/{ref}/{path}`

Returns file bytes resolved by ref and path, with a sniffed content type and browser-safe response headers.

<h3 id="read-a-raw-file-with-content-type-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|Artifacts namespace name.|
|name|path|string|true|Repository name.|
|ref|path|string|true|Git ref, branch, tag, or 40-character commit hash.|
|path|path|string|true|File path. May contain slashes.|
|account_id|path|string|true|Cloudflare account ID.|

## List repository tokens

<a id="opIdartifacts_repo_tokens_list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/tokens`

## Read a Git tree

<a id="opIdartifacts_repos_tree_get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/string/artifacts/namespaces/string/repos/string/tree/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/tree/{hash}`

Returns decoded entries for an immutable Git tree object. A commit hash returns that commit's root tree; a blob or tag hash returns 422. Tree responses are cacheable forever by hash.

<h3 id="read-a-git-tree-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|Artifacts namespace name.|
|name|path|string|true|Repository name.|
|hash|path|string|true|40-character lowercase hexadecimal Git object hash.|
|account_id|path|string|true|Cloudflare account ID.|
