## Generate Pre-Shared Key (PSK) for IPsec tunnels

<a id="opIdmagic-ipsec-tunnels-generate-pre-shared-key-(-psk)-for-ipsec-tunnels"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/magic/ipsec_tunnels/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/psk_generate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Auth-Email: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "X-Auth-Key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/magic/ipsec_tunnels/{ipsec_tunnel_id}/psk_generate`

Generates a Pre-Shared Key for a specific IPsec tunnel used in the IKE session. Use `?validate_only=true` as an optional query parameter to only run validation without persisting changes. After a PSK is generated, the PSK is immediately persisted to Cloudflare's edge and cannot be retrieved later. Store the PSK in a safe place.

<h3 id="generate-pre-shared-key-psk-for-ipsec-tunnels-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ipsec_tunnel_id|path|[magic_identifier](#schemamagic_identifier)|true|none|
|account_id|path|[magic_identifier](#schemamagic_identifier)|true|none|

> Example responses

```json

  "errors": [],
  "messages": [],
  "result": {
    "ipsec_tunnel_id": "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353",
    "psk": "O3bwKSjnaoCxDoUxjcq4Rk8ZKkezQUiy",
    "psk_metadata": {
      "last_generated_on": "2017-06-14T05:20:00Z"
    }
  },
  "success": true
}
```

> Body parameter

```json
{
```
```json
  "bond_id": 2,
  "ha_link": true,
  "is_breakout": true,
  "is_prioritized": true,
  "name": "string",
  "nat": {
    "static_prefix": "192.0.2.0/24"
  },
  "physport": 1,
  "routed_subnets": [
    {
      "nat": {
        "static_prefix": "192.0.2.0/24"
      },

    }
  ],
  "static_addressing": {
    "address": "192.0.2.0/24",
    "dhcp_relay": {
      "server_addresses": [
        "192.0.2.1"
      ]
    },
    "dhcp_server": {
      "dhcp_options": [
        {
          "code": 66,
          "type": "ip",
          "value": "10.20.30.40"
        }
      ],
      "dhcp_pool_end": "192.0.2.1",
      "dhcp_pool_start": "192.0.2.1",
      "dns_server": {},
      "dns_servers": [
        "192.0.2.1"
      ],

        "00:11:22:33:44:55": "192.0.2.100",
        "AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF": "192.168.1.101"
      }
    },
    "secondary_address": "192.0.2.0/24",
    "virtual_address": "192.0.2.0/24"
  },
  "vlan_tag": 42
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-new-site-lan-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[magic_identifier](#schemamagic_identifier)|true|none|
|site_id|path|[magic_identifier](#schemamagic_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|[magic_lans_add_single_request](#schemamagic_lans_add_single_request)|true|none|
|» bond_id|body|[magic_bond_id](#schemamagic_bond_id)|false|none|
|» ha_link|body|boolean|false|mark true to use this LAN for HA probing. only works for site with HA turned on. only one LAN can be set as the ha_link.|
|» is_breakout|body|boolean|false|mark true to use this LAN for source-based breakout traffic|
|» is_prioritized|body|boolean|false|mark true to use this LAN for source-based prioritized traffic|
|» name|body|string|false|none|
|» nat|body|[magic_nat](#schemamagic_nat)|false|none|
|» physport|body|[magic_port](#schemamagic_port)|false|none|
|» routed_subnets|body|[[magic_routed_subnet](#schemamagic_routed_subnet)]|false|none|
|» static_addressing|body|[magic_lan_static_addressing](#schemamagic_lan_static_addressing)|false|If the site is not configured in high availability mode, this configuration is optional (if omitted, use DHCP). However, if in high availability mode, static_address is required along with secondary and virtual address.|
|» vlan_tag|body|[magic_vlan_tag](#schemamagic_vlan_tag)|false|VLAN ID. Use zero for untagged.|


`PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/magic/sites/{site_id}/wans/{wan_id}`

Patch a specific Site WAN.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "health_check_rate": "low",
  "load_balance_inner_flows": true,
  "name": "string",
  "physport": 1,
  "priority": 0,
  "provisioned_download_kbps": 500,
  "provisioned_upload_kbps": 100,
  "static_addressing": {
    "address": "192.0.2.0/24",
    "gateway_address": "192.0.2.1",
    "secondary_address": "192.0.2.0/24",
    "secondary_gateway_address": "192.0.2.1"
  },
  "vlan_tag": 42
}
```

<h3 id="patch-site-wan-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|site_id|path|[magic_identifier](#schemamagic_identifier)|true|none|
|account_id|path|[magic_identifier](#schemamagic_identifier)|true|none|
|wan_id|path|[magic_identifier](#schemamagic_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|[magic_wan_update_request](#schemamagic_wan_update_request)|true|none|
|» health_check_rate|body|string|false|Magic WAN health check rate for tunnels created on this link.|
|» load_balance_inner_flows|body|boolean \| null|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|none|
|» physport|body|[magic_port](#schemamagic_port)|false|none|
|» priority|body|integer|false|none|
|» provisioned_download_kbps|body|integer \| null|false|Provisioned download rate of the WAN circuit in kilobits per second. Set to null to remove it.|
|» provisioned_upload_kbps|body|integer \| null|false|Provisioned upload rate of the WAN circuit in kilobits per second. Set to null to remove it.|
|» static_addressing|body|[magic_wan_static_addressing_update](#schemamagic_wan_static_addressing_update)|false|Static addressing configuration. PATCH updates only the fields provided, and PUT replaces the configuration.|
|» vlan_tag|body|[magic_vlan_tag](#schemamagic_vlan_tag)|false|VLAN ID. Use zero for untagged.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» health_check_rate|low|
|» health_check_rate|mid|
|» health_check_rate|high|

```json
    "static_addressing": {

      "secondary_address": "192.0.2.0/24",

    },
```

## Create repository

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/managed-defense/vulnerability-discovery/repos \
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/managed-defense/vulnerability-discovery/repos`

Creates an upload repository or reserves an asynchronous deployed Worker import by name. Worker imports require Idempotency-Key. Push upload source to `main` or specify the `branch` to scan in the scan request.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "worker_script_name": "string"
}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|

|account_id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[managed-defense-vulnerability-discovery_CreateRepositoryRequest](#schemamanaged-defense-vulnerability-discovery_createrepositoryrequest)|true|none|

## Create scan

<a id="opIdcreateAccountVulnerabilityDiscoveryScan"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/managed-defense/vulnerability-discovery/scans \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "repos": [
      {
        "branch": "string",
        "hosts": [
          "string"
        ],
        "name": "string"
      }
    ],
    "telemetry_window": {
      "end": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "start": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/managed-defense/vulnerability-discovery/scans`

Submits repository intent for operator review. This endpoint does not immediately start execution. Worker-imported repositories must be ready; explicit repository host scopes must be authorized and explicit branch selections must exist before the request is persisted.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "repos": [
    {
      "branch": "string",
      "hosts": [
        "string"
      ],
      "name": "string"
    }
  ],
  "telemetry_window": {
    "end": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "start": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-scan-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|Optional. Supply this header to safely retry a request. Required when `worker_script_name` is supplied.|
|account_id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[managed-defense-vulnerability-discovery_CreateScan](#schemamanaged-defense-vulnerability-discovery_createscan)|true|none|
|» repos|body|[object]|true|Repository names must be unique within a request.|
|» » branch|body|string|false|Branch to scan. Defaults to the repository's default branch.|
|» » hosts|body|[string]|false|Explicit hostname scopes. Every hostname must be authorized for this repository before review admission; rejected scopes return 422 and do not persist a scan request.|
|» » name|body|string|true|none|
|» telemetry_window|body|[managed-defense-vulnerability-discovery_TelemetryWindow](#schemamanaged-defense-vulnerability-discovery_telemetrywindow)|false|UTC ISO-8601 interval. Start is inclusive, end is exclusive, and the interval must be positive and at most seven days.|

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/6f91088a406011ed95aed352566e8d4c/mnm/rules/2890e6fa406311ed9b5a23f70f6fb8cf \
```

```bash
  -d '{
    "automatic_advertisement": "false",
    "bandwidth_threshold": 1000,
    "duration": "300s",
    "name": "my_rule_1",
    "packet_threshold": 10000,
    "prefix_match": "exact",
    "prefixes": [
      "203.0.113.1/32"
    ],
    "type": "zscore",
    "zscore_sensitivity": "high",
    "zscore_target": "bits"
  }'
```

`PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/mnm/rules/{rule_id}`

Update a network monitoring rule for account.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "automatic_advertisement": "false",
  "bandwidth_threshold": 1000,
  "duration": "300s",
  "name": "my_rule_1",
  "packet_threshold": 10000,
  "prefix_match": "exact",
  "prefixes": [
    "203.0.113.1/32"
  ],
  "type": "zscore",
  "zscore_sensitivity": "high",
  "zscore_target": "bits"
}
```

<h3 id="update-rule-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|rule_id|path|[magic-visibility-mnm_rule_identifier](#schemamagic-visibility-mnm_rule_identifier)|true|none|
|account_id|path|[magic-visibility-mnm_account_identifier](#schemamagic-visibility-mnm_account_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|[magic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_create](#schemamagic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_create)|true|none|
|» automatic_advertisement|body|[magic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_automatic_advertisement](#schemamagic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_automatic_advertisement)|true|Toggle on if you would like Cloudflare to automatically advertise the IP Prefixes within the rule via Magic Transit when the rule is triggered. Only available for users of Magic Transit.|
|» bandwidth_threshold|body|[magic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_bandwidth_threshold](#schemamagic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_bandwidth_threshold)|false|The number of bits per second for the rule. When this value is exceeded for the set duration, an alert notification is sent. Minimum of 1 and no maximum.|
|» duration|body|[magic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_duration](#schemamagic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_duration)|false|The amount of time that the rule threshold must be exceeded to send an alert notification. The final value must be equivalent to one of the following 8 values ["1m","5m","10m","15m","20m","30m","45m","60m"].|
|» name|body|[magic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_name](#schemamagic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_name)|true|The name of the rule. Must be unique. Supports characters A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore (_), dash (-), period (.), and tilde (~). You can’t have a space in the rule name. Max 256 characters.|
|» packet_threshold|body|[magic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_packet_threshold](#schemamagic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_packet_threshold)|false|The number of packets per second for the rule. When this value is exceeded for the set duration, an alert notification is sent. Minimum of 1 and no maximum.|
|» prefix_match|body|[magic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_prefix_match](#schemamagic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_prefix_match)|false|Prefix match type to be applied for a prefix auto advertisement when using an advanced_ddos rule.|
|» prefixes|body|[magic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_ip_prefixes](#schemamagic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_ip_prefixes)|true|none|
|» type|body|[magic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_type](#schemamagic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_type)|true|MNM rule type.|
|» zscore_sensitivity|body|[magic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_zscore_sensitivity](#schemamagic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_zscore_sensitivity)|false|Level of sensitivity set for zscore rules.|
|» zscore_target|body|[magic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_zscore_target](#schemamagic-visibility-mnm_mnm_rule_zscore_target)|false|Target of the zscore rule analysis.|

## Update a payment rule

<a id="opIdmonetization-patch-rule"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/9f1839b6152d298aca64c4e906b6d074/monetization/rules/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "address": "0x1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678===",
    "description": "Premium API endpoint",
    "enabled": true,
    "expression": "(http.request.uri.path eq \"/premium\" and http.request.method in {\"GET\" \"POST\"})",
    "price": "250000",
    "scheme": "exact"
  }'
```

`PATCH /zones/{zone_id}/monetization/rules/{rule_id}`

Applies a partial update to a single Payment Required rule. Only the fields present in the request body are changed; omitted fields keep their current values. Returns the full resulting rule collection.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "address": "0x1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678===",
  "description": "Premium API endpoint",
  "enabled": true,
  "expression": "(http.request.uri.path eq \"/premium\" and http.request.method in {\"GET\" \"POST\"})",
  "price": "250000",
  "scheme": "exact"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-payment-rule-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|zone_id|path|[monetization_zone-identifier](#schemamonetization_zone-identifier)|true|none|
|rule_id|path|[monetization_identifier](#schemamonetization_identifier)|true|The unique ID of the payment rule.|
|body|body|[monetization_monetization-rule-patch](#schemamonetization_monetization-rule-patch)|true|none|
|» address|body|string|false|0x-prefixed 20-byte hexadecimal Ethereum address. Mixed-case addresses must carry a valid EIP-55 checksum; all-lowercase or all-uppercase addresses are also accepted. The effective address must pass wallet screening whenever the rule is patched.|
|» description|body|string|false|none|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|none|
|» expression|body|string|false|Wirefilter expression identifying the requests that require payment. Forwarded verbatim to the Rulesets API, which validates its syntax.|
|» price|body|[monetization_monetization-price](#schemamonetization_monetization-price)|false|Price in the smallest indivisible unit of the configured payment token, encoded as a decimal string. Must be a canonical decimal integer in [1000, 100000000]: no leading zeros, and a bare JSON number is rejected. The price is required for the fixed-price schemes ("exact" and "upto") and must be at least 1000, the smallest amount the payment facilitator can settle ($0.001 for a 6-decimal token such as USDC), and at most 100000000 ($100 for a 6-decimal token). When the scheme is "origin_controlled" the origin server sets pricing dynamically and the rule carries no price: the field must be omitted — any provided value, including "0", is rejected because it would not be enforced. Responses always encode this as a string and omit it for "origin_controlled" rules; the pattern matches exactly the set of values the server accepts.|
|» scheme|body|[monetization_monetization-scheme](#schemamonetization_monetization-scheme)|false|X402 payment scheme. "exact" requires the specified payment amount; "upto" permits a payment up to the specified amount; "origin_controlled" lets the origin server set pricing dynamically, in which case the rule carries no price and the price field must be omitted.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» scheme|exact|
|» scheme|upto|
|» scheme|origin_controlled|

```json
    }
```

<h1 id="cloudflare-api-moq-relays">MoQ Relays</h1>

## List relays

<a id="opIdmoq-relays-list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/moq/relays \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays`

Lists all MoQ relays for the account. Returns only metadata.
Config, status, and tokens are omitted.

Results are cursor-paginated (keyset on the `created` timestamp).
Use `created_before` / `created_after` with the `created` value of the
first/last item in a page to fetch the adjacent page. `result_info`
reports the page `count` and the `total` matching the cursor filters.


<h3 id="list-relays-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[moq_account_identifier](#schemamoq_account_identifier)|true|Cloudflare account identifier.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time)|false|Cursor for pagination. Returns relays created strictly before this<br>RFC 3339 timestamp (typically the `created` value of the first item<br>on the current page, to fetch the previous page).<br>|
|created_after|query|string(date-time)|false|Cursor for pagination. Returns relays created strictly after this<br>RFC 3339 timestamp (typically the `created` value of the last item<br>on the current page, to fetch the next page).<br>|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Maximum number of relays to return per page. Values above the maximum are<br>clamped to it rather than rejected.<br>|
|asc|query|boolean|false|Sort order by `created`. When true, results are returned oldest-first<br>(ascending); otherwise newest-first (descending, the default).<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 0,
      "message": "string"
    }
  ],
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": 0,
      "message": "string"
    }
  ],
  "success": true,
  "result": [
    {
      "created": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "modified": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "name": "string",
      "uid": "a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f67890"
    }
  ],
  "result_info": {
    "count": 0,
    "total": 0
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 21007,
      "message": "A MoQ relay with this ID was not found."
    }
  ],
  "messages": [
    {}
  ],
  "result": {},
  "success": false
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 21007,
      "message": "A MoQ relay with this ID was not found."
    }
  ],
  "messages": [
    {}
  ],
  "result": {},
  "success": false
}
```

## Create a relay

<a id="opIdmoq-relays-create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/moq/relays \

  -d '{
    "name": "Production Live Stream"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays`

Provisions a new MoQ relay instance. Auto-creates a publish+subscribe
token and a subscribe-only token. Token values are included in the
response (shown once). Config is always set to defaults (upstreams
off) and cannot be supplied here — sending a non-empty `config` is
rejected (21014); `null` or `{}` is accepted as absent. Use PUT to
configure the relay after it exists.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "Production Live Stream"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-relay-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[moq_account_identifier](#schemamoq_account_identifier)|true|Cloudflare account identifier.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Human-readable name for the relay.|

## Update a relay

<a id="opIdmoq-relays-update"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/moq/relays/a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f67890 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "config": {
      "upstreams": {
        "enabled": false,
        "upstreams": []
      }
    },
    "name": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays/{relay_id}`

Updates a relay's name and/or configuration. The relay ID goes in
the URL path — `PUT /accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays/{relay_id}` —
not the request body; there is no collection-level update endpoint.
This is also the only way to set a relay's config (config cannot be
set at create time). Partial updates: omitted fields are preserved;
config sub-objects replace as whole objects when present.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "config": {
    "upstreams": {
      "enabled": false,
      "upstreams": []
    }
  },
  "name": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-relay-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[moq_account_identifier](#schemamoq_account_identifier)|true|Cloudflare account identifier.|
|relay_id|path|string|true|Relay unique identifier (32 hex characters).|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» config|body|object|false|none|
|» » upstreams|body|[moq_upstreams](#schemamoq_upstreams)|false|Upstreams are external MOQT server publishers that a relay falls back<br>to when it has no local publisher for a requested namespace/track.<br>|
|» name|body|string|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 0,
      "message": "string"
    }
  ],
  "messages": [
```

## List tokens

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays/{relay_id}/tokens`

Returns metadata for every token the relay accepts. Secrets are never
returned, so a token that has been lost cannot be recovered here. There
is no expiry filter: compare each token's `expires` to the current time
to tell which ones have lapsed.

## Create a token

<a id="opIdmoq-relays-tokens-create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/moq/relays/a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f67890/tokens \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "expires": "2027-03-27T15:00:00Z",
    "label": "primary-encoder",
    "operations": [
      "publish",
      "subscribe"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays/{relay_id}/tokens`

Mints a new relay-scoped token and adds it to the relay's accepted-auth
registry. The token value (secret) is shown once in the response. A relay
may hold up to 10 tokens; creating an 11th is rejected.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "expires": "2027-03-27T15:00:00Z",
  "label": "primary-encoder",
  "operations": [
    "publish",
    "subscribe"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-token-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[moq_account_identifier](#schemamoq_account_identifier)|true|Cloudflare account identifier.|
|relay_id|path|string|true|Relay unique identifier (32 hex characters).|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» expires|body|string(date-time)|false|Optional expiry (RFC 3339). Defaults to 1 year from creation;<br>rejected if more than 1 year in the future.<br>|
|» label|body|string|false|Optional, customer-set label.|
|» operations|body|[string]|true|Non-empty subset of the V1 roles the token is allowed to<br>perform. Signed into the token.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» operations|publish|
|» operations|subscribe|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "errors": [

      "message": "string"

  ],

    {
      "code": 0,
      "message": "string"
    }
  ],
  "success": true,
  "result": {
    "issuers": [
      {
        "cloudflare_tokens": [
          {
            "created": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
            "expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
            "jti": "f3a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f678",
            "label": "primary-encoder",
            "operations": [
              "publish",
              "subscribe"
            ],
            "secret": "eyJhbGciOiJFZDI1NTE5..."
          }
        ],
        "issuer": "cloudflare",
        "type": "cloudflare_jwt"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Revoke a token

<a id="opIdmoq-relays-tokens-delete"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/moq/relays/a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f67890/tokens/f3a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f678 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays/{relay_id}/tokens/{jti}`

Revokes a token by removing it from the set the relay accepts. Relays
cache that set, so revocation takes effect within seconds rather than
instantly, and connections already established with the token are not
closed. Revoking an unknown token succeeds, so the call is idempotent.


<h3 id="revoke-a-token-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[moq_account_identifier](#schemamoq_account_identifier)|true|Cloudflare account identifier.|
|relay_id|path|string|true|Relay unique identifier (32 hex characters).|
|jti|path|string|true|Token identifier (jti — 32 hex characters).|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 0,
      "message": "string"
    }
  ],
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": 0,
      "message": "string"
    }
  ],
  "success": true
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 21007,
      "message": "A MoQ relay with this ID was not found."
    }
  ],
  "messages": [
    {}
  ],
  "result": {},
  "success": false
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 21007,
      "message": "A MoQ relay with this ID was not found."
    }
  ],
  "messages": [
    {}
  ],
  "result": {},
  "success": false
}
```

```json
{

    {
      "code": 21007,
      "message": "A MoQ relay with this ID was not found."
    }
  ],
  "messages": [
    {}
  ],
  "result": {},
  "success": false
}
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/mtls_certificates`

Upload a certificate that you want to use with mTLS-enabled Cloudflare services, such as Bring Your Own CA (BYO-CA) for mTLS. To create certificates issued by the Cloudflare managed CA, use the [Create Client Certificate endpoint](/api/resources/client_certificates/methods/create/).

<h3 id="upload-mtls-certificate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_identifier](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» ca|body|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_ca](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_ca)|true|Indicates whether the certificate is a CA or leaf certificate.|
|» certificates|body|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_certificates-2](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_certificates-2)|true|The uploaded root CA certificate.|
|» name|body|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_name-2](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_name-2)|false|Optional unique name for the certificate. Only used for human readability.|
|» private_key|body|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_private_key-4](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_private_key-4)|false|The private key for the certificate. This field is only needed for specific use cases such as using a custom certificate with Zero Trust's block page.|

<h3 id="upload-mtls-certificate-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **4XX**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|errors|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_messages](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_messages)|true|none|none|
|messages|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_messages](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_messages)|true|none|none|
|success|boolean|true|none|Whether the API call was successful.|
|result|object|true|none|none|
|» ca|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_ca](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_ca)|false|none|Indicates whether the certificate is a CA or leaf certificate.|
|» certificates|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_certificates-2](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_certificates-2)|false|none|The uploaded root CA certificate.|
|» expires_on|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_expires_on-2](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_expires_on-2)|false|read-only|When the certificate expires.|
|» id|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_mtls_certificate_identifier](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_mtls_certificate_identifier)|false|read-only|Certificate identifier tag.|

|» name|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_name-2](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_name-2)|false|none|Optional unique name for the certificate. Only used for human readability.|
|» serial_number|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_serial_number-2](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_serial_number-2)|false|read-only|The certificate serial number.|
|» signature|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_signature](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_signature)|false|read-only|The type of hash used for the certificate.|
|» type|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_type-3](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_type-3)|false|read-only|The type of the certificate, indicating how it was created and who manages it.|
|» updated_at|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_updated_at-4](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_updated_at-4)|false|none|This is the time the certificate was updated.|
|» uploaded_on|[tls-certificates-and-hostnames_uploaded_on-4](#schematls-certificates-and-hostnames_uploaded_on-4)|false|none|This is the time the certificate was uploaded.|
|errors|object|true|none|none|
|*anonymous*|[object]|false|none|none|
|» code|integer|true|none|none|
|» documentation_url|string|false|none|none|
|» message|string|true|none|none|

## Get mTLS certificate

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/oauth_clients`

```json
  ],
```

## List integrations

<a id="opIdlist_integrations_v2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/one/integrations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/one/integrations`

Returns a paginated list of integrations for the account.

<h3 id="list-integrations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|Cloudflare account identifier.|
|application|query|string|false|Filter by application/vendor (e.g., GOOGLE_WORKSPACE, MICROSOFT_INTERNAL).|
|direction|query|string|false|Direction to order results.|
|dlp_enabled|query|boolean|false|Filter by DLP enabled status (true/false).|
|order|query|string|false|Field to order results by.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number within the paginated result set.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|Number of results per page.|
|search|query|string|false|Search integrations by name or application.|
|status|query|string|false|Filter by integration status.|
|use_cases|query|string|false|Filter by enabled use cases (e.g., casb, ces). Matches integrations enrolled in any of the specified values. Can be specified multiple times.|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|

|direction|desc|
|order|application|
|order|created|
|order|name|
|order|status|
|status|Healthy|
|status|Initializing|
|status|Offline|
|status|Unhealthy|

## Create integration

<a id="opIdcreate_integration_v2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/one/integrations \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "application": "GOOGLE_WORKSPACE",
    "auth_method": "service_account",
    "credentials": {
      "admin_email": "admin@corp.com"
    },
    "dlp_profiles": [
      "e91a2360-da51-4fdf-9711-bcdecd462614"
    ],
    "name": "My Google Workspace",
    "permissions": [
      "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly"
    ],
    "use_cases": [
      "casb",
      "ces"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/one/integrations`

Creates a new integration for the specified application. Integration creation with OAuth is not supported by API at the moment. For other auth methods, use `GET /v2/applications/{application_id}/credential-guide` to see the required credential structure and example payloads for each vendor.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "application": "GOOGLE_WORKSPACE",
  "auth_method": "service_account",
  "credentials": {
    "admin_email": "admin@corp.com"
  },
  "dlp_profiles": [
    "e91a2360-da51-4fdf-9711-bcdecd462614"
  ],
  "name": "My Google Workspace",
  "permissions": [
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly"
  ],
  "use_cases": [
    "casb",
    "ces"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-integration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|Cloudflare account identifier.|
|body|body|[one_IntegrationV2CreateRequest](#schemaone_integrationv2createrequest)|true|none|
|» application|body|string|true|Vendor/application slug (e.g., GOOGLE_WORKSPACE).<br><br>* `ANTHROPIC` - ANTHROPIC<br>* `AWS` - AWS<br>* `BITBUCKET` - BITBUCKET<br>* `BOX` - BOX<br>* `CONFLUENCE` - CONFLUENCE<br>* `DROPBOX` - DROPBOX<br>* `GITHUB` - GITHUB<br>* `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PLATFORM` - GOOGLE_CLOUD_PLATFORM<br>* `GOOGLE_WORKSPACE` - GOOGLE_WORKSPACE<br>* `JIRA` - JIRA<br>* `MICROSOFT_INTERNAL` - MICROSOFT_INTERNAL<br>* `OPENAI` - OPENAI<br>* `SALESFORCE` - SALESFORCE<br>* `SERVICENOW` - SERVICENOW<br>* `SLACK` - SLACK<br>* `ZOOM` - ZOOM|
|» auth_method|body|string \| null|false|Authentication method slug (uses default if omitted).|
|» credentials|body|object|true|Credentials for the integration.|
|» dlp_profiles|body|[string(uuid)]|false|List of DLP profile IDs to associate.|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the integration.|
|» permissions|body|[string]|false|List of permission scopes (uses policy defaults if empty).|
|» use_cases|body|[string]|true|List of use case or feature slugs to enroll. At least one use case (casb, ces) is required; auto_remediation may be added alongside casb (e.g., ['casb', 'ces', 'auto_remediation']).|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» application|ANTHROPIC|
|» application|AWS|
|» application|BITBUCKET|
|» application|BOX|
|» application|CONFLUENCE|
|» application|DROPBOX|
|» application|GITHUB|
|» application|GOOGLE_CLOUD_PLATFORM|
|» application|GOOGLE_WORKSPACE|
|» application|JIRA|
|» application|MICROSOFT_INTERNAL|
|» application|OPENAI|
|» application|SALESFORCE|
|» application|SERVICENOW|
|» application|SLACK|
|» application|ZOOM|
|» use_cases|casb|
|» use_cases|ces|
|» use_cases|auto_remediation|

<h1 id="cloudflare-api-pages-project">Pages Project</h1>

## List Cloudflare Pages projects

<a id="opIdpages-project-get-projects"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/pages/projects \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects`

List the Cloudflare Pages projects in an account.

<h3 id="list-cloudflare-pages-projects-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[pages_identifier](#schemapages_identifier)|true|none|
|page|query|integer|false|none|
|per_page|query|integer|false|none|

|success|boolean|true|none|Whether the API call was successful.|
|result_info|object|false|none|none|
|» count|number|false|none|Total number of results for the requested service.|
|» page|number|false|none|Current page within paginated list of results.|
|» per_page|number|false|none|Number of results per page of results.|
|» total_count|number|false|none|Total results available without any search parameters.|
|» total_pages|number|false|none|The number of total pages in the entire result set.|
|result|[[pages_project](#schemapages_project)]|true|none|none|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|success|true|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Create project response.|Inline|

<h3 id="create-a-cloudflare-pages-project-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|errors|[pages_messages](#schemapages_messages)|true|none|none|
|messages|[pages_messages](#schemapages_messages)|true|none|none|
|success|boolean|true|none|Whether the API call was successful.|
|result|[pages_project](#schemapages_project)|true|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|success|true|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_token, api_email & api_key
</aside>

## Get a Cloudflare Pages project

<a id="opIdpages-project-get-project"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/pages/projects/this-is-my-project-01 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}`

Retrieve the configuration and deployment settings for a Cloudflare Pages project.

<h3 id="get-a-cloudflare-pages-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|project_name|path|[pages_project_name](#schemapages_project_name)|true|none|
|account_id|path|[pages_identifier](#schemapages_identifier)|true|none|

## Update a Cloudflare Pages project

<a id="opIdpages-project-update-project"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/pages/projects/this-is-my-project-01 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "deployment_configs": {
      "production": {
        "compatibility_date": "2022-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "compatibility_flags": [
          "url_standard"
        ],
        "env_vars": {
          "NODE_VERSION": {
            "value": "22"
          },
          "delete_this_env_var": null,
          "secret_var": {
            "type": "secret_text",
            "value": "A_CMS_API_TOKEN"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}`

Update the build, deployment, source, or environment settings for a Cloudflare Pages project. To delete an environment variable, set its key to `null`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "deployment_configs": {
    "production": {
      "compatibility_date": "2022-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "compatibility_flags": [
        "url_standard"
      ],
      "env_vars": {
        "NODE_VERSION": {
          "value": "22"
        },
        "delete_this_env_var": null,
        "secret_var": {
          "type": "secret_text",
          "value": "A_CMS_API_TOKEN"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Connect a Git repository

<a id="opIdpages-project-connect-project-source"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/pages/projects/this-is-my-project-01/source \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "config": {
      "deployments_enabled": true,
      "owner": "my-org",
      "owner_id": "12345678",
      "path_excludes": [
        "string"
      ],
      "path_includes": [
        "string"
      ],
      "pr_comments_enabled": true,
      "preview_branch_excludes": [
        "string"
      ],
      "preview_branch_includes": [
        "string"
      ],
      "preview_deployment_setting": "all",
      "production_branch": "main",
      "production_deployments_enabled": true,
      "repo_id": "12345678",
      "repo_name": "my-repo"
    },
    "type": "github"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/source`

Connect a GitHub or GitLab repository to a Cloudflare Pages project to enable Git-based deployments.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "config": {
    "deployments_enabled": true,
    "owner": "my-org",
    "owner_id": "12345678",
    "path_excludes": [
      "string"
    ],
    "path_includes": [
      "string"
    ],
    "pr_comments_enabled": true,
    "preview_branch_excludes": [
      "string"
    ],
    "preview_branch_includes": [
      "string"
    ],
    "preview_deployment_setting": "all",
    "production_branch": "main",
    "production_deployments_enabled": true,
    "repo_id": "12345678",
    "repo_name": "my-repo"
  },
  "type": "github"
}
```

<h3 id="connect-a-git-repository-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|project_name|path|[pages_project_name](#schemapages_project_name)|true|none|
|account_id|path|[pages_identifier](#schemapages_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|[pages_source_connect_request](#schemapages_source_connect_request)|true|none|
|» config|body|object|true|none|
|» » deployments_enabled|body|boolean|true|**Deprecated.** Whether to enable automatic deployments when pushing to the source repository.<br>When disabled, no deployments (production or preview) will be triggered automatically.<br>|
|» » owner|body|string|true|The owner of the repository.|
|» » owner_id|body|string|true|The owner ID of the repository.|
|» » path_excludes|body|[string]|true|A list of paths that should be excluded from triggering a preview deployment. Wildcard syntax (`*`) is supported.|
|» » path_includes|body|[string]|true|A list of paths that should be watched to trigger a preview deployment. Wildcard syntax (`*`) is supported.|
|» » pr_comments_enabled|body|boolean|true|Whether to enable PR comments.|
|» » preview_branch_excludes|body|[string]|true|A list of branches that should not trigger a preview deployment. Wildcard syntax (`*`) is supported. Must be used with `preview_deployment_setting` set to `custom`.|
|» » preview_branch_includes|body|[string]|true|A list of branches that should trigger a preview deployment. Wildcard syntax (`*`) is supported. Must be used with `preview_deployment_setting` set to `custom`.|
|» » preview_deployment_setting|body|string|true|Controls whether commits to preview branches trigger a preview deployment.|
|» » production_branch|body|string|true|The production branch of the repository.|
|» » production_deployments_enabled|body|boolean|true|Whether to trigger a production deployment on commits to the production branch.|
|» » repo_id|body|string|true|The ID of the repository.|
|» » repo_name|body|string|true|The name of the repository.|
|» type|body|[pages_source_type](#schemapages_source_type)|true|The source control management provider.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » preview_deployment_setting|all|
|» » preview_deployment_setting|none|
|» » preview_deployment_setting|custom|
|» type|github|
|» type|gitlab|

## Disconnect a Git repository

<a id="opIdpages-project-disconnect-project-source"></a>

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/pages/projects/this-is-my-project-01/source \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/source`

Disconnect the Git repository from a Cloudflare Pages project to stop Git-based deployments.

|---|---|---|---|---|
|project_name|path|[pages_project_name](#schemapages_project_name)|true|none|
|account_id|path|[pages_identifier](#schemapages_identifier)|true|none|

## Create a Pages deployment

<a id="opIdpages-deployment-create-deployment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/pages/projects/this-is-my-project-01/deployments \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F '_headers=@/path/to/file' \
  -F '_redirects=@/path/to/file' \
  -F '_routes.json=@/path/to/file' \
  -F '_worker.bundle=@/path/to/file' \
  -F '_worker.js=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'branch=staging' \
  -F 'commit_dirty=false' \
  -F 'commit_hash=a1b2c3d4e5f6' \
  -F 'commit_message=Update homepage' \
  -F 'functions-filepath-routing-config.json=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'manifest={"index.html": "abc123", "style.css": "def456"}' \
  -F 'pages_build_output_dir=dist' \
  -F 'wrangler_config_hash=string'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/deployments`

Create a Cloudflare Pages deployment from a Git branch or Direct Upload manifest. Git repositories must already be authorized in Cloudflare Pages.

> Body parameter

```yaml
_headers: string
_redirects: string
_routes.json: string
_worker.bundle: string
_worker.js: string
branch: staging
commit_dirty: "false"
commit_hash: a1b2c3d4e5f6
commit_message: Update homepage
functions-filepath-routing-config.json: string
manifest: "{\"index.html\": \"abc123\", \"style.css\": \"def456\"}"
pages_build_output_dir: dist
wrangler_config_hash: string
```

<h3 id="create-a-pages-deployment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|project_name|path|[pages_project_name](#schemapages_project_name)|true|none|
|account_id|path|[pages_identifier](#schemapages_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» _headers|body|string(binary)|false|Headers configuration file for the deployment.|
|» _redirects|body|string(binary)|false|Redirects configuration file for the deployment.|
|» _routes.json|body|string(binary)|false|Routes configuration file defining routing rules.|
|» _worker.bundle|body|string(binary)|false|Worker bundle file in multipart/form-data format. Mutually exclusive with `_worker.js`.<br>Cannot specify both `_worker.js` and `_worker.bundle` in the same request.<br>Maximum size: 25 MiB.<br>|
|» _worker.js|body|string(binary)|false|Worker JavaScript file. Mutually exclusive with `_worker.bundle`.<br>Cannot specify both `_worker.js` and `_worker.bundle` in the same request.<br>|
|» branch|body|string|false|Git branch to deploy. Uses the branch's `HEAD`; defaults to the project's production branch.|
|» commit_dirty|body|string|false|Whether the associated Git working tree has uncommitted changes. Provide `true` or `false`.|
|» commit_hash|body|string|false|Git commit SHA associated with the deployment.|
|» commit_message|body|string|false|Git commit message associated with the deployment.|
|» functions-filepath-routing-config.json|body|string(binary)|false|Functions routing configuration file.|
|» manifest|body|string|false|JSON-encoded object mapping deployment file paths to their uploaded content hashes.<br>Required for Direct Upload deployments. Maximum 20,000 entries.<br>|
|» pages_build_output_dir|body|string|false|The build output directory path.|
|» wrangler_config_hash|body|string|false|Hash of the Wrangler configuration file used for this deployment.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» commit_dirty|true|
|» commit_dirty|false|

<h1 id="cloudflare-api-ppuenableddomains">ppu_enabled_domains</h1>

## List enabled Pay Per Use domains

<a id="opIdpay-per-use.listEnabledDomains"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/string/pay-per-use/enabled-domains \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Auth-Email: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "X-Auth-Key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/pay-per-use/enabled-domains`

Returns publisher domains associated with the requesting Pay Per Use operator through an accepted price agreement. License expiration is the earlier non-null boundary from the price agreement and publisher zone lifecycles. A future expiration remains active and is exposed to the operator. After expiration, the license remains listed as expired for one calendar month before it is omitted; an active agreement for the same domain takes precedence. The requesting account must be an active Pay Per Use operator.

<h3 id="list-enabled-pay-per-use-domains-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|Account identifier for the participant|
|cursor|query|string|false|Opaque, account-bound cursor returned by the previous page. Cursors expire after one hour; restart pagination without a cursor after receiving a 400 response for an expired cursor.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Maximum number of domains to return|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "result": {
    "cursor": "string",
    "domains": [
      {
```

## Set pay-per-use operator configuration

<a id="opIdpay-per-crawl.putPPUOperatorConfiguration"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/string/pay-per-use/operator/configuration \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

  -H "X-Auth-Key: ${API_KEY}" \

    "enabled": true,
    "name": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /accounts/{account_id}/pay-per-use/operator/configuration`

Creates or updates the pay-per-use operator configuration for an account. Creating an enabled configuration or re-enabling a disabled billable operator requires completed Stripe onboarding, while non-billable operators do not; an already-enabled operator is not affected by later Stripe status changes. A Cloudflare-verified operator's name and default price cannot be changed.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "default_price_usd_microcents": 100000,
  "enabled": true,
  "name": "string"
}
```

## Update pay-per-use zone configuration

<a id="opIdpay-per-crawl.patchPPUZoneConfiguration"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/string/pay-per-use/configuration \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Auth-Email: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "X-Auth-Key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "enabled": true
  }'
```

`PATCH /zones/{zone_id}/pay-per-use/configuration`

Enables or disables an existing pay-per-use zone configuration. Omitting enabled leaves the zone unchanged. Enabling a disabled billable zone requires completed publisher Stripe onboarding, while non-billable zones do not; an already-enabled zone is not affected by later Stripe status changes. Disabling starts a disabled period immediately while existing accepted licenses remain active until the start of the next UTC month; re-enabling before expiry clears the schedule and restores those licenses.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "enabled": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-pay-per-use-zone-configuration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|zone_id|path|string|true|zone id|
|body|body|[pay-per-crawl_PPUZoneConfigurationUpdate](#schemapay-per-crawl_ppuzoneconfigurationupdate)|true|Pay-per-use zone configuration update|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|none|

## Decide a pay-per-use price proposal

<a id="opIdpay-per-crawl.postPPUProposalDecision"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/string/pay-per-use/proposals \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Auth-Email: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "X-Auth-Key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "action": "accept",
    "price_id": 1
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/pay-per-use/proposals`

Accepts or rejects the pending pay-per-use price proposal identified by price_id in the request body. Acceptance requires an enabled operator with a verified name, an enabled publisher zone, and matching billing classifications; rejection remains available for cleanup.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "action": "accept",
  "price_id": 1
}
```

|» action|body|string|true|none|
|» price_id|body|integer(int64)|true|Pending pay-per-use price id returned in the operator proposal queue.|

## Set a pay-per-use operator price

<a id="opIdpay-per-crawl.postPPUPublisherPriceAction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/string/pay-per-use/operators/stringstringstringstringstringst/price \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Auth-Email: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "X-Auth-Key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "action": "propose",
    "price_usd_microcents": 100000
  }'
```

`POST /zones/{zone_id}/pay-per-use/operators/{operator_id}/price`

Proposes a required price, withdraws a pending proposal, accepts an operator's default pay-per-use price, or resumes an accepted price before its scheduled expiry. Propose, accept_default, and resume require an enabled operator with a verified name, an enabled publisher zone, and matching billing classifications.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "action": "propose",
  "price_usd_microcents": 100000
}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
|zone_id|path|string|true|zone id|
|operator_id|path|string|true|Stable pay-per-use operator identifier.|
|body|body|[pay-per-crawl_PPUPublisherPriceActionRequest](#schemapay-per-crawl_ppupublisherpriceactionrequest)|true|Pay-per-use publisher price action|
|» *oneOf*|body|[pay-per-crawl_PPUPublisherPriceProposeRequest](#schemapay-per-crawl_ppupublisherpriceproposerequest)|false|none|

<h1 id="cloudflare-api-ppuusagestats">ppu_usage_stats</h1>

## Get pay-per-use usage statistics

<a id="opIdpay-per-crawl.getPPUUsageStats"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/string/pay-per-use/usage-stats?since=1970-01-01T00%3A00%3A00Z&until=1970-01-01T00%3A00%3A00Z' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Auth-Email: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "X-Auth-Key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/pay-per-use/usage-stats`

Returns reported usage and the full gross value across all Pay Per Use zones in a publisher account over an explicit UTC range of at most 31 days. Usage from every domain and snapshotted price is summed by buyer. Ranges up to and including 7 days use hourly data points; longer ranges use daily data points. Because source data is aggregated hourly, both requested bounds are rounded down to the selected UTC interval and the resolved bounds are returned in the response. The resolved range must contain at least one complete interval. Empty periods are omitted. Buyers and their data points are paginated, while totals cover every buyer in the range. Values are raw usage counts and USD microcents; total_price_usd_microcents is the full value before the publisher revenue share.

<h3 id="get-pay-per-use-usage-statistics-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|account id|
|since|query|string(date-time)|true|Requested inclusive beginning of the statistics range as an RFC3339 timestamp. Rounded down to the selected UTC interval.|
|until|query|string(date-time)|true|Requested exclusive end of the statistics range as an RFC3339 timestamp. Rounded down to the selected UTC interval. The requested duration from since cannot exceed 31 days.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Results per page.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "result": {
    "buyers": [
      {
        "operator_id": "stringstringstringstringstringst",
        "operator_name": "string",
        "total_price_usd_microcents": 1,
        "usage_count": 1
      }
    ],
    "data": [
      {
        "operator_id": "stringstringstringstringstringst",
        "operator_name": "string",

      "usage_count": 0
    },
    "until": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  },
  "result_info": {
    "count": 0,
    "page": 0,
    "per_page": 0,
    "total_count": 0,
    "total_pages": 0
  },
  "success": true
}
```

<h1 id="cloudflare-api-r2-object">R2 Object</h1>

## List Objects

<a id="opIdr2-list-objects"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/r2/buckets/example-bucket/objects \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/r2/buckets/{bucket_name}/objects`

Lists objects in an R2 bucket. Returns object metadata including key, size, etag, last modified date, HTTP metadata, and custom metadata.

For most workloads, we recommend using R2's [S3-compatible API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/s3/api/) or a [Worker with an R2 binding](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/workers/workers-api-reference/) instead.


<h3 id="list-objects-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[r2_account_identifier](#schemar2_account_identifier)|true|none|
|bucket_name|path|[r2_bucket_name](#schemar2_bucket_name)|true|none|
|cf-r2-jurisdiction|header|string|false|Jurisdiction where objects in this bucket are guaranteed to be stored.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|none|
|prefix|query|string|false|none|
|delimiter|query|string|false|none|
|cursor|query|string|false|none|
|start_after|query|string|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|cf-r2-jurisdiction|default|
|cf-r2-jurisdiction|eu|
|cf-r2-jurisdiction|us|
|cf-r2-jurisdiction|fedramp|
|cf-r2-jurisdiction|fedramp-high|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 1000,
```

## Delete Objects

<a id="opIdr2-delete-objects"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/r2/buckets/example-bucket/objects \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '[
    "path/to/object-a.txt",
    "path/to/object-b.txt"
  ]'
```

`DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/r2/buckets/{bucket_name}/objects`

Deletes the listed objects from an R2 bucket. Provide a JSON array of 1 to 1000 object
keys in the request body.

If any key cannot be deleted (for example, because it does not exist or is locked), the
remaining keys are still deleted, but the response is HTTP 200 with `success: false`,
`result: null` and one entry in `errors` per failed key. The entries in `errors` do not
identify which key failed.

To delete every object under a prefix, or to empty a bucket, create a `prefixDelete` job
with the Create Bucket Job endpoint instead. The `prefix` query parameter on this endpoint
is deprecated; it creates the same job, but responses to it carry a `Deprecation` header
and a message pointing to Create Bucket Job.

For most workloads, we recommend using R2's [S3-compatible API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/s3/api/) or a [Worker with an R2 binding](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/workers/workers-api-reference/) instead.


> Body parameter

```json
[
  "path/to/object-a.txt",
  "path/to/object-b.txt"
]
```

<h3 id="delete-objects-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[r2_account_identifier](#schemar2_account_identifier)|true|none|
|bucket_name|path|[r2_bucket_name](#schemar2_bucket_name)|true|none|
|cf-r2-jurisdiction|header|string|false|Jurisdiction where objects in this bucket are guaranteed to be stored.|
|prefix|query|string|false|**Deprecated.** Deprecated. Create a `prefixDelete` job with the Create Bucket Job endpoint instead.<br>When present, the request body is ignored and a prefix-delete job is created for this<br>prefix, exactly as Create Bucket Job does; an empty value empties the bucket. The<br>response is the job descriptor, with a `Deprecation` header and a deprecation message<br>in `messages`.<br>|
|cf-r2-data-catalog-check|header|string|false|Set this header to reject the operation when R2 Data Catalog is enabled for the bucket.|
|body|body|[string]|false|A JSON array of 1 to 1000 object keys to delete. Required unless the deprecated `prefix` parameter is present.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|cf-r2-jurisdiction|default|
|cf-r2-jurisdiction|eu|
|cf-r2-jurisdiction|us|
|cf-r2-jurisdiction|fedramp|
|cf-r2-jurisdiction|fedramp-high|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [],
  "messages": [],
  "result": [
    {
      "key": "path/to/object-a.txt"
    },
    {
      "key": "path/to/object-b.txt"
    }
  ],
  "success": true
}
```

> 4XX Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 1000,
      "message": "string"
    }
  ],
  "messages": [
    "string"
  ],
  "result": null,
  "success": false
}
```

<h3 id="delete-objects-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Delete Objects response. When every key is deleted, `result` contains a `{ key }` entry<br>for each deleted object. When any key fails, `success` is `false`, `result` is `null`<br>and `errors` has one entry per failed key; the other keys are still deleted. With the<br>deprecated `prefix` parameter, `result` is the created prefix-delete job.<br>|Inline|
|4XX|Client Error|Delete Objects response failure. The bucket may not exist, the request may be invalid, or the caller may not be authorized.|[r2_v4_response_failure](#schemar2_v4_response_failure)|

<h3 id="delete-objects-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|none|
|errors|[r2_errors](#schemar2_errors)|true|none|none|
|messages|[r2_messages](#schemar2_messages)|true|none|none|
|result|[[r2_r2_delete_object_result](#schemar2_r2_delete_object_result)]|true|none|The deleted objects.|
|success|boolean|true|none|Whether the API call was successful.|
|*oneOf*|[r2_v4_response_failure](#schemar2_v4_response_failure)|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|**Deprecated.**|
|errors|[r2_errors](#schemar2_errors)|true|none|none|
|messages|[r2_messages](#schemar2_messages)|true|none|none|
|result|[r2_prefix_delete_job](#schemar2_prefix_delete_job)|true|none|Descriptor of a prefix-delete job. An empty prefix indicates a job that empties the<br>whole bucket.<br>|
|success|boolean|true|none|Whether the API call was successful.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|success|true|
|success|true|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|

|200|Content-Type|string||The MIME type of the object.|

|200|Last-Modified|string||The date and time the object was last modified, formatted as an HTTP-date (RFC 7231),<br>e.g. `Tue, 15 Jan 2024 10:30:00 GMT`.<br>|

## Upload Object

<a id="opIdr2-put-object"></a>

`PUT /accounts/{account_id}/r2/buckets/{bucket_name}/objects/{object_key}`

Uploads an object to an R2 bucket. The object body is provided as the request body. Returns metadata about the uploaded object.

The maximum upload size for this endpoint is 300 MB. For most workloads, we recommend using R2's [S3-compatible API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/s3/api/) or a [Worker with an R2 binding](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/workers/workers-api-reference/) instead.

|Content-Type|header|string|false|none|
|Content-Length|header|integer|false|none|
|cf-r2-storage-class|header|[r2_storage_class](#schemar2_storage_class)|false|Storage class for this object. Overrides the bucket default.|
|body|body|string(binary)|true|none|

## Fetch all livestreams

<a id="opIdfetch_all_livestreams"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/realtime/kit/14a396e7-ca44-4937-bf1f-050a69118543/livestreams \

  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/livestreams`

Returns details of livestreams associated with the given App ID. It includes livestreams created by your App and RealtimeKit meetings that are livestreamed by your App. If you only want details of livestreams created by your App and not RealtimeKit meetings, you can use the `exclude_meetings` query parameter.

<h3 id="fetch-all-livestreams-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|exclude_meetings|query|boolean|false|Exclude the RealtimeKit meetings that are livestreamed.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of results per page.|
|page_no|query|integer|false|The page number from which you want your page search results to be displayed.|
|status|query|string|false|Specifies the status of the operation.|
|start_time|query|string(date-time)|false|Specify the start time range in ISO format to access the live stream.|
|end_time|query|string(date-time)|false|Specify the end time range in ISO format to access the live stream.|
|sort_order|query|string|false|Specifies the sorting order for the results.|
|account_id|path|[realtimekit_account_identifier](#schemarealtimekit_account_identifier)|true|none|
|app_id|path|[realtimekit_app_id](#schemarealtimekit_app_id)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|LIVE|
|status|IDLE|
|status|ERRORED|
|status|INVOKED|
|sort_order|ASC|
|sort_order|DSC|

```json
    }
  ],

    "end_offset": 1,
    "start_offset": 1,
    "total_count": 1
  },
  "success": true
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/meetings/{meeting_id}/participants`

Adds a participant to the given meeting ID.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "custom_participant_id": "string",
  "name": "Mary Sue",
  "picture": "https://i.imgur.com/test.jpg",
  "preset_name": "group_call_host",
  "token": {
    "expires_on": "2026-10-01T11:00:00Z",
    "not_before": "2026-10-01T09:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-participant-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[realtimekit_account_identifier](#schemarealtimekit_account_identifier)|true|none|
|app_id|path|[realtimekit_app_id](#schemarealtimekit_app_id)|true|none|
|meeting_id|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the meeting. Fetch the meeting ID using the create a meeting API.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» custom_participant_id|body|string|true|A unique participant ID. You must specify a unique ID for the participant, for example, UUID, email address, and so on. |
|» name|body|string \| null|false|(Optional) Name of the participant. |
|» picture|body|string(uri) \| null|false|(Optional) A URL to a picture to be used for the participant. |
|» preset_name|body|string|true|Name of the preset to apply to this participant.|
|» token|body|[realtimekit_ParticipantTokenValidity](#schemarealtimekit_participanttokenvalidity)|false|Validity window of the participant authentication token. The window is [not_before, expires_on) and cannot be longer than 100 days. Defaults to a token valid from now for 100 days.|

```json
    "name": "string",
```

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": 0,
    "details": null,
    "message": "string",
    "reason": "participant_token_expired"
  },
  "success": false
}
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/meetings/{meeting_id}/participants/{participant_id}/token`

Regenerates participant's authentication token for the given meeting and participant ID.

```json
  "not_before": "2026-10-01T09:00:00Z"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/presets/{preset_id}`

Fetches details of a preset using the provided preset ID

<h3 id="fetch-details-of-a-preset-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[realtimekit_account_identifier](#schemarealtimekit_account_identifier)|true|none|
|app_id|path|[realtimekit_app_id](#schemarealtimekit_app_id)|true|none|
|preset_id|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the preset to fetch|

## Delete a preset

<a id="opIddelete-presets-preset_id"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/realtime/kit/14a396e7-ca44-4937-bf1f-050a69118543/presets/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/presets/{preset_id}`

Deletes a preset using the provided preset ID

<h3 id="delete-a-preset-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[realtimekit_account_identifier](#schemarealtimekit_account_identifier)|true|none|
|app_id|path|[realtimekit_app_id](#schemarealtimekit_app_id)|true|none|
|preset_id|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the preset to fetch|

## Update a preset

<a id="opIdpatch-presets-preset_id"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/realtime/kit/14a396e7-ca44-4937-bf1f-050a69118543/presets/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "config": {
      "livestream_viewer_qualities": [],
      "max_screenshare_count": 0,
      "max_video_streams": {
        "desktop": 0,
        "mobile": 0
      },
      "media": {
        "audio": {
          "enable_high_bitrate": true,
          "enable_stereo": true
        },
        "screenshare": {
          "frame_rate": 0,
          "quality": "hd"
        },
        "video": {
          "frame_rate": 0,
          "quality": "hd",
          "simulcast": true
        }
      },
      "view_type": "GROUP_CALL"
    },
    "name": "string",
    "permissions": {
      "accept_stage_requests": true,
      "accept_waiting_requests": true,
      "can_accept_production_requests": true,
      "can_change_participant_permissions": true,
      "can_edit_display_name": true,
      "can_livestream": true,
      "can_record": true,
      "can_spotlight": true,
      "chat": {
        "private": {
          "can_receive": true,
          "can_send": true,
          "files": true,
          "text": true
        },
        "public": {
          "can_send": true,
          "files": true,
          "text": true
        }
      },
      "connected_meetings": {
        "can_alter_connected_meetings": true,
        "can_switch_connected_meetings": true,
        "can_switch_to_parent_meeting": true
      },
      "disable_participant_audio": true,
      "disable_participant_screensharing": true,
      "disable_participant_video": true,
      "hidden_participant": true,
      "is_recorder": true,
      "kick_participant": true,
      "media": {
        "audio": {
          "can_produce": "ALLOWED"
        },
        "screenshare": {
          "can_produce": "ALLOWED"
        },
        "video": {
          "can_produce": "ALLOWED"
        }
      },
      "pin_participant": true,
      "plugins": {
        "can_close": true,
        "can_edit_config": true,
        "can_start": true,
        "config": {
          "property1": {
            "access_control": "FULL_ACCESS",
            "handles_view_only": true
          },
          "property2": {
            "access_control": "FULL_ACCESS",
            "handles_view_only": true
          }
        }
      },
      "polls": {
        "can_create": true,
        "can_view": true,
        "can_vote": true
      },
      "recorder_type": "RECORDER",
      "show_participant_list": true,
      "stage_access": "ALLOWED",
      "stage_enabled": true,
      "transcription_enabled": true,
      "waiting_room_type": "SKIP"
    },
    "ui": {
      "design_tokens": {
        "border_radius": "sharp",
        "border_width": "none",
        "colors": {
          "background": {
            "600": "string",
            "700": "string",
            "800": "string",
            "900": "string",
            "1000": "string"
          },
          "brand": {
            "300": "string",
            "400": "string",
            "500": "string",
            "600": "string",
            "700": "string"
          },
          "danger": "string",
          "success": "string",
          "text": "string",
          "text_on_brand": "string",
          "video_bg": "string",
          "warning": "string"
        },
        "font_family": "string",
        "google_font": "string",
        "logo": "http://example.com",
        "spacing_base": 1,
        "theme": "darkest"
      }
    }
  }'
```

<h1 id="cloudflare-api-recordings">Recordings</h1>

## Fetch all recordings for an App

<a id="opIdget_all_recordings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/realtime/kit/14a396e7-ca44-4937-bf1f-050a69118543/recordings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/recordings`

Returns all recordings for an App. If the `meeting_id` parameter is passed, returns all recordings for the given meeting ID.

<h3 id="fetch-all-recordings-for-an-app-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[realtimekit_account_identifier](#schemarealtimekit_account_identifier)|true|none|
|app_id|path|[realtimekit_app_id](#schemarealtimekit_app_id)|true|none|
|meeting_id|query|string(uuid)|false|ID of a meeting. Optional. Will limit results to only this meeting if passed.|
|page_no|query|number|false|The page number from which you want your page search results to be displayed.|
|per_page|query|number|false|Number of results per page|
|expired|query|boolean|false|If passed, only shows expired/non-expired recordings on RealtimeKit's bucket|
|search|query|string|false|The search query string. You can search using the meeting ID or title.|
|sort_by|query|string|false|none|
|sort_order|query|string|false|none|
|start_time|query|string(date-time)|false|The start time range for which you want to retrieve the meetings. The time must be specified in ISO format.|
|end_time|query|string(date-time)|false|The end time range for which you want to retrieve the meetings. The time must be specified in ISO format.|
|status|query|[string]|false|Filter by one or more recording status|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sort_by|invokedTime|
|sort_order|ASC|
|sort_order|DESC|
|status|INVOKED|
|status|RECORDING|
|status|UPLOADING|
|status|UPLOADED|
|status|ERRORED|
|status|PAUSED|

## Start recording a meeting

<a id="opIdstart_recording"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/realtime/kit/14a396e7-ca44-4937-bf1f-050a69118543/recordings \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "allow_multiple_recordings": false,
    "audio_config": {
      "channel": "stereo",
      "codec": "AAC",
      "export_file": true
    },
    "file_name_prefix": "string",
    "interactive_config": {
      "type": "ID3"
    },
    "max_seconds": 60,
    "meeting_id": "97440c6a-140b-40a9-9499-b23fd7a3868a",
    "realtimekit_bucket_config": {
      "enabled": true
    },
    "video_config": {
      "codec": "H264",
      "export_file": true,
      "height": 720,
      "watermark": {
        "position": "left top",
        "size": {
          "height": 1,
          "width": 1
        },
        "url": "http://example.com"
      },
      "width": 1280
    }
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/recordings`

Starts recording a meeting. The meeting can be started by an App admin directly, or a participant with permissions to start a recording, based on the type of authorization used.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "allow_multiple_recordings": false,
  "audio_config": {
    "channel": "stereo",
    "codec": "AAC",
    "export_file": true
  },
  "file_name_prefix": "string",
  "interactive_config": {
    "type": "ID3"
  },
  "max_seconds": 60,
  "meeting_id": "97440c6a-140b-40a9-9499-b23fd7a3868a",
  "realtimekit_bucket_config": {
    "enabled": true
  },
  "video_config": {
    "codec": "H264",
    "export_file": true,
    "height": 720,
    "watermark": {
      "position": "left top",
      "size": {
        "height": 1,
        "width": 1
      },
      "url": "http://example.com"
    },
    "width": 1280
  }
}
```

<h3 id="start-recording-a-meeting-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[realtimekit_account_identifier](#schemarealtimekit_account_identifier)|true|none|
|app_id|path|[realtimekit_app_id](#schemarealtimekit_app_id)|true|none|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» allow_multiple_recordings|body|boolean|false|By default, a meeting allows only one recording to run at a time. Enabling the `allow_multiple_recordings` parameter to true allows you to initiate multiple recordings concurrently in the same meeting. This allows you to record separate videos of the same meeting with different configurations, such as portrait mode or landscape mode.|
|» audio_config|body|[realtimekit_AudioConfig](#schemarealtimekit_audioconfig)|false|Object containing configuration regarding the audio that is being recorded.|
|» file_name_prefix|body|string|false|Update the recording file name.|
|» interactive_config|body|[realtimekit_InteractiveConfig](#schemarealtimekit_interactiveconfig)|false|Allows you to add timed metadata to your recordings, which are digital markers inserted into a video file to provide contextual information at specific points in the content range. The ID3 tags containing this information are available to clients on the playback timeline in HLS format. The output files are generated in a compressed .tar format.|
|» max_seconds|body|integer|false|Specifies the maximum duration for recording in seconds, ranging from a minimum of 60 seconds to a maximum of 24 hours.|
|» meeting_id|body|string(uuid)|true|ID of the meeting to record.|
|» realtimekit_bucket_config|body|[realtimekit_realtimekitBucketConfig](#schemarealtimekit_realtimekitbucketconfig)|false|none|
|» rtmp_out_config|body|[realtimekit_LivestreamingConfig](#schemarealtimekit_livestreamingconfig)|false|none|
|» storage_config|body|[realtimekit_StorageConfig](#schemarealtimekit_storageconfig)|false|none|
|» url|body|string(uri)|false|Pass a custom url to record arbitary screen|
|» video_config|body|[realtimekit_VideoConfig](#schemarealtimekit_videoconfig)|false|none|
