## Start recording participant audio tracks

<a id="opIdstartTrackRecordingForAMeeting"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/realtime/kit/14a396e7-ca44-4937-bf1f-050a69118543/recordings/track \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "meeting_id": "97440c6a-140b-40a9-9499-b23fd7a3868a"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/recordings/track`

Starts track recording for a meeting. Track recording currently records separate participant audio tracks as WebM files in the RealtimeKit bucket. Video track recording is in development. For more information, refer to [Track recording](/realtime/realtimekit/recording-guide/track-recording/).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "meeting_id": "97440c6a-140b-40a9-9499-b23fd7a3868a"
}
```

<h3 id="start-recording-participant-audio-tracks-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[realtimekit_account_identifier](#schemarealtimekit_account_identifier)|true|none|
|app_id|path|[realtimekit_app_id](#schemarealtimekit_app_id)|true|none|
|body|body|object|true|Starts audio track recording for an active meeting. Use `layers` only when you need to set a file name prefix. Selective track recording (`user_ids`) is in early beta contact support to use this feature.|
|» layers|body|object|false|Optional audio layer configuration. If omitted, RealtimeKit records all participant audio using the default file name prefix.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[realtimekit_TrackConfigLayer](#schemarealtimekit_trackconfiglayer)|false|none|
|» meeting_id|body|string(uuid)|true|ID of the meeting to record.|
|» user_ids|body|[string]|false|Optional list of participant user IDs to record. Selective track recording (`user_ids`) is in early beta contact support to use this feature.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "recording": {
      "audio_download_url": "http://example.com",
      "download_url": "http://example.com",
      "download_url_expiry": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "file_size": 0,
      "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "invoked_time": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "output_file_name": "string",

      "session_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "started_time": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "status": "INVOKED",
      "stopped_time": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    }
  },
  "success": true
}
```

## Fetch details of a session

<a id="opIdGetSessionDetails"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/realtime/kit/14a396e7-ca44-4937-bf1f-050a69118543/sessions/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/sessions/{session_id}`

Returns data of the given session ID including recording details.

<h3 id="fetch-details-of-a-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[realtimekit_account_identifier](#schemarealtimekit_account_identifier)|true|none|
|app_id|path|[realtimekit_app_id](#schemarealtimekit_app_id)|true|none|
|include_breakout_rooms|query|boolean|false|List all breakout rooms|
|session_id|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the session|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "associated_id": "string",
    "breakout_rooms": [
      {}
    ],
    "created_at": "string",
    "ended_at": "string",
    "id": "string",
    "live_participants": 0,
    "max_concurrent_participants": 0,
    "meeting_display_name": "string",
    "minutes_consumed": 0,
    "organization_id": "string",
    "started_at": "string",
    "status": "LIVE",
    "type": "meeting",
    "updated_at": "string"
  },
  "success": true
}
```

<h3 id="fetch-details-of-a-session-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Get details about a particular session|Inline|

<h3 id="fetch-details-of-a-session-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[realtimekit_ActiveSession](#schemarealtimekit_activesession)|false|none|none|
|success|boolean|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_token
</aside>

## Fetch all chat messages of a session

<a id="opIdGetSessionChat"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/realtime/kit/14a396e7-ca44-4937-bf1f-050a69118543/sessions/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/chat \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/sessions/{session_id}/chat`

Returns a URL to download all chat messages of the session ID in CSV format.


<h3 id="fetch-all-chat-messages-of-a-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[realtimekit_account_identifier](#schemarealtimekit_account_identifier)|true|none|
|app_id|path|[realtimekit_app_id](#schemarealtimekit_app_id)|true|none|
|session_id|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the session|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "chat_download_url": "string",
    "chat_download_url_expiry": "string"
  },
  "success": true
}
```

<h3 id="fetch-all-chat-messages-of-a-session-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returns all chat messages of a session.|Inline|

<h3 id="fetch-all-chat-messages-of-a-session-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[realtimekit_ChatMessage](#schemarealtimekit_chatmessage)|false|none|none|
|success|boolean|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_token
</aside>

## Fetch participants list of a session

<a id="opIdGetSessionParticipants"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/realtime/kit/14a396e7-ca44-4937-bf1f-050a69118543/sessions/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/participants \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/sessions/{session_id}/participants`

Returns a list of participants for the given session ID.

<h3 id="fetch-participants-list-of-a-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[realtimekit_account_identifier](#schemarealtimekit_account_identifier)|true|none|
|app_id|path|[realtimekit_app_id](#schemarealtimekit_app_id)|true|none|
|search|query|string|false|The search query string. You can search using participant ID, custom participant ID, or display name.|
|page_no|query|number|false|The page number from which you want your page search results to be displayed.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of results per page.|
|sort_order|query|string|false|none|
|sort_by|query|string|false|none|
|include_peer_events|query|boolean|false|if true, response includes all the peer events of participants.|
|view|query|string|false|In breakout room sessions, the view parameter can be set to `raw` for session specific duration for participants or `consolidated` to accumulate breakout room durations.|
|session_id|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the session|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sort_order|ASC|
|sort_order|DESC|
|sort_by|joinedAt|
|sort_by|duration|
|view|raw|
|view|consolidated|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
      },
      {
        "created_at": "2023-02-01T10:50:36.853Z",
```

## Add a webhook

<a id="opIdaddWebhook"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/realtime/kit/14a396e7-ca44-4937-bf1f-050a69118543/webhooks \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "enabled": true,
    "events": [
      "meeting.started",
      "meeting.ended",
      "meeting.participantJoined",
      "meeting.participantLeft",
      "meeting.chatSynced",
      "recording.statusUpdate",
      "livestreaming.statusUpdate",
      "meeting.transcript",
      "meeting.summary"
    ],
    "name": "All events webhook",
    "url": "https://webhook.site/b23a5bbd-c7b0-4ced-a9e2-78ae7889897e"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/webhooks`

Adds a new webhook to an App.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "events": [
    "meeting.started",
    "meeting.ended",
    "meeting.participantJoined",
    "meeting.participantLeft",
    "meeting.chatSynced",
    "recording.statusUpdate",
    "livestreaming.statusUpdate",
    "meeting.transcript",
    "meeting.summary"
  ],
  "name": "All events webhook",
  "url": "https://webhook.site/b23a5bbd-c7b0-4ced-a9e2-78ae7889897e"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[realtimekit_account_identifier](#schemarealtimekit_account_identifier)|true|none|
|app_id|path|[realtimekit_app_id](#schemarealtimekit_app_id)|true|none|
|body|body|[realtimekit_WebhookRequest](#schemarealtimekit_webhookrequest)|true|none|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|Set whether or not the webhook should be active when created|
|» events|body|[string]|true|Events that this webhook will get triggered by|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the webhook|
|» url|body|string(uri)|true|URL this webhook will send events to|

|Parameter|Value|

|» events|meeting.started|
|» events|meeting.ended|
|» events|meeting.participantJoined|
|» events|meeting.participantLeft|
|» events|meeting.chatSynced|
|» events|recording.statusUpdate|
|» events|livestreaming.statusUpdate|
|» events|meeting.transcript|
|» events|meeting.summary|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "created_at": "2022-05-28T07:01:53.075Z",
    "enabled": true,
    "events": [
      "meeting.started",
      "meeting.ended",
      "meeting.participantJoined",
      "meeting.participantLeft",
      "meeting.chatSynced",
      "recording.statusUpdate",
      "livestreaming.statusUpdate",
      "meeting.transcript",
      "meeting.summary"
    ],
    "id": "0d1f069d-43bb-489a-ad8c-7eb95592ba8e",
    "name": "All events webhook",
    "updated_at": "2022-05-28T07:01:53.075Z",
    "url": "https://webhook.site/b23a5bbd-c7b0-4ced-a9e2-78ae7889897e"
  },

}
```

<h1 id="cloudflare-api-domain-discovery">Domain Discovery</h1>

## Check domain availability

<a id="opIdsandbox-registrar-domain-discovery-check"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/registrar-sandbox/domain-check \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "domains": [
      "myawesomebrand.com",
      "myawesomebrand.net",
      "myawesomebrand.org",
      "myawesomebrand.app",
      "myawesomebrand.dev"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/registrar-sandbox/domain-check`

Performs real-time, authoritative availability checks directly against domain
registries. Use this endpoint to verify a domain is available before attempting
registration via `POST /registrations`.

**Important:** Unlike the Search endpoint, these results are authoritative and
reflect current registry status. Always check availability immediately before
registration as domain status can change rapidly.

**Note:** This endpoint uses POST to accept a list of domains in the request
body. It is a read-only operation — it does not create, modify, or reserve
any domains.

### Extension support

Only domains on extensions supported for programmatic registration by this API
can be registered. If you check a domain on an unsupported extension, the response
will include `registrable: false` with a `reason` field explaining why:

- `extension_not_supported_via_api` — Cloudflare Registrar supports this extension
  in the dashboard, but it is not yet available for programmatic registration via
  this API. Register via `https://dash.cloudflare.com/{account_id}/domains/registrations` instead.
- `extension_not_supported` — This extension is not supported by Cloudflare
  Registrar.
- `extension_disallows_registration` — The extension's registry has temporarily
  or permanently frozen new registrations. No registrar can register domains on
  this extension at this time.
- `domain_premium` — The domain is premium priced. Premium registration is not
  currently supported by this API.
- `domain_unavailable` — The domain is already registered, reserved, or otherwise
  not available for registration on a supported extension.

The `reason` field is only present when `registrable` is `false`.

### Behavior
- Maximum 20 domains per request
- Pricing is only returned for domains where `registrable: true`
- Results are not cached; each request queries the registry

### Workflow
1. Call this endpoint with domains the user wants to register.
2. For each domain where `registrable: true`, present pricing to the user.
3. If `tier: premium`, note that premium registration is not currently
   supported by this API and do not proceed to `POST /registrations`.
4. Proceed to `POST /registrations` only for supported non-premium domains.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "domains": [
    "myawesomebrand.com",
    "myawesomebrand.net",
    "myawesomebrand.org",
    "myawesomebrand.app",
    "myawesomebrand.dev"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="check-domain-availability-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[registrar-api-sandbox_identifier](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_identifier)|true|Cloudflare account ID. Required for all Registrar API operations.|
|body|body|[registrar-api-sandbox_domain_check_request](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_domain_check_request)|true|List of fully qualified domain names (FQDNs) to check. Each domain must include the extension (e.g., "example.com", not "example").|
|» domains|body|[string]|true|List of fully qualified domain names (FQDNs) to check for availability. Each domain must include the extension.<br>- Minimum: 1 domain.<br>- Maximum: 20 domains per request.<br>- The response returns domains on unsupported extensions with `registrable: false` and a `reason` field.<br>- The response may omit malformed domain names (e.g., names missing an extension).<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [],
  "messages": [],
  "result": {
    "domains": [
      {
        "name": "xq7mz9brand.com",
        "pricing": {
          "currency": "USD",
          "registration_cost": "8.57",
          "renewal_cost": "8.57"
        },
        "registrable": true,
        "tier": "standard"
      },
      {
        "name": "xq7mz9brand.net",
        "pricing": {
          "currency": "USD",
          "registration_cost": "9.95",
          "renewal_cost": "9.95"
        },
        "registrable": true,
        "tier": "standard"
      }
    ]
  },
  "success": true
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 1006,
      "message": "domains array must contain at least one domain"
    }
  ],
  "messages": [],
  "result": null,
  "success": false
}
```

<h3 id="check-domain-availability-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successfully returned availability results. Each requested domain appears in the `domains` array with its current availability status and pricing (if available).|[registrar-api-sandbox_domain_check_response](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_domain_check_response)|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid request parameters.<br>Common causes include:<br>- Empty `domains` array.<br>- More than 20 domains per request.<br>- Malformed request body.<br>- Zero valid domains after validation.<br>|[registrar-api-sandbox_api-response-common-failure](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_api-response-common-failure)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_token, api_email & api_key
</aside>

## Search for available domains

<a id="opIdsandbox-registrar-domain-discovery-search"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/registrar-sandbox/domain-search?q=coffee%20shop' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/registrar-sandbox/domain-search`

Searches for domain name suggestions based on a keyword, phrase, or partial domain name.
Returns a list of potentially available domains with pricing information.

**Important:** Results are non-authoritative and based on cached data. Always use the
`/domain-check` endpoint to verify real-time availability before attempting registration.

Suggestions are scoped to extensions supported for programmatic registration
via this API (`POST /registrations`). Domains on unsupported extensions will
not appear in results, even if they are available at the registry level.

### Use cases
- Brand name discovery (e.g., "acme corp" → acmecorp.com, acmecorp.dev)
- Keyword-based suggestions (e.g., "coffee shop" → coffeeshop.com, mycoffeeshop.net)
- Alternative extension discovery (e.g., "example.com" → example.com, example.app, example.xyz)

### Workflow
1. Call this endpoint with a keyword or domain name.
2. Present suggestions to the user.
3. Call `/domain-check` with the user's chosen domains to confirm real-time availability and pricing.
4. Proceed to `POST /registrations` only for supported non-premium domains
   where the Check response returns `registrable: true`.

**Note:** Searching with just a domain extension (e.g., "com" or ".app") is not supported. Provide a keyword or domain name.


<h3 id="search-for-available-domains-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[registrar-api-sandbox_identifier](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_identifier)|true|Cloudflare account ID. Required for all Registrar API operations.|
|q|query|string|true|The search term to find domain suggestions. Accepts keywords, phrases, or full domain names.<br>- Phrases: "coffee shop" returns coffeeshop.com, mycoffeeshop.net, etc.<br>- Domain names: "example.com" returns example.com and variations across extensions<br>|
|extensions|query|[string]|false|Limits results to specific domain extensions from the supported set. If not specified,<br>returns results across all supported extensions. Extensions not in the supported<br>set are silently ignored.<br>|
|limit|query|integer|false|Maximum number of domain suggestions to return. Defaults to 20 if not specified.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [],
  "messages": [],
  "result": {
    "domains": [
      {
        "name": "acmecorp.com",
        "pricing": {
          "currency": "USD",
          "registration_cost": "8.57",
          "renewal_cost": "8.57"
        },
        "registrable": true,
        "tier": "standard"
      },
      {
        "name": "acmecorp.dev",
        "pricing": {
          "currency": "USD",
          "registration_cost": "10.11",
          "renewal_cost": "10.11"
        },
        "registrable": true,
        "tier": "standard"
      },
      {
        "name": "acmecorp.app",
        "pricing": {
          "currency": "USD",
          "registration_cost": "11.00",
          "renewal_cost": "11.00"
        },
        "registrable": true,
        "tier": "standard"
      }
    ]
  },
  "success": true
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 1002,
      "message": "Parameter q exceeds maximum length of 100 characters"
    }
  ],
  "messages": [],
  "result": null,
  "success": false
}
```

<h3 id="search-for-available-domains-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successfully returned domain search results.|[registrar-api-sandbox_domain_search_response](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_domain_search_response)|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid request parameters.<br>Common causes include:<br>- Missing required `q` parameter.<br>- Query exceeds 100 character limit.<br>- Invalid extension format.<br>|[registrar-api-sandbox_api-response-common-failure](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_api-response-common-failure)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_token, api_email & api_key
</aside>

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/registrar/domain-transfer-check \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "domains": [
      {
        "domain_name": "example.co.uk"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/registrar/domain-transfer-check`

Performs real-time, authoritative eligibility checks directly against needed requirements.
Use this endpoint to verify a domain is available before
attempting a transfer via `POST /registrations/:domain_name/transfer-in`.

**Note:** This endpoint uses POST to accept a list of domains in the request
body. It is a read-only operation — it does not create, modify, or reserve
any domains.

### Behavior
- Maximum 10 domains per request
- Pricing is only returned for domains where `transferable: true`
- Results are not cached; each request queries the registry & other needed upstreams

## Extension Support

All `.uk` extensions (`.uk`, `.co.uk`, etc) do not support auth codes. As such,
Cloudflare will ignore the `auth_code` section of this request for `.uk` domains.

This means that a `.uk` domain depends on public data to obtain domain information,
so it might be a few minutes outdated.

### Workflow
1. Call this endpoint with domains the user wants to transfer.
2. For each domain where `transferable: true`, present pricing to the user.
3. For each domain where `transferable: false`, present reasons to the user
4. Proceed to `POST /registrations/:domain_name/transfer-in` only for the `transferable: true` domains.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "domains": [
    {
      "domain_name": "example.co.uk"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="check-domain-transfer-eligibility-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[registrar-api_identifier](#schemaregistrar-api_identifier)|true|Cloudflare account ID. Required for all Registrar API operations.|
|body|body|[registrar-api_domain_transfer_check_request](#schemaregistrar-api_domain_transfer_check_request)|true|List of transferable domain objects to check.|
|» domains|body|[object]|true|List of domain objects to evaluate for transfer eligibility.|
|» » auth_code|body|string(byte)|false|Base64-encoded auth/EPP code from the current registrar.<br>Required for most TLDs. `.uk` namespaces do not use auth<br>codes.<br>|
|» » domain_name|body|string|true|Fully qualified domain name (FQDN) to check for transfer eligibility.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [],
  "messages": [],
  "result": {
    "domains": {
      "example.com": {
        "name": "example.com",
        "pricing": {
          "currency": "USD",
          "renewal_cost": "10.11",
          "transfer_cost": "8.57"
        },
        "reasons": [],
        "transferable": true
      },
      "mybrand.net": {
        "name": "mybrand.net",
        "pricing": {
          "currency": "USD",
          "renewal_cost": "12.50",
          "transfer_cost": "9.99"
        },
        "reasons": [],
        "transferable": true
      }
    }
  },
  "success": true
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 10000,
      "message": "object at root is missing required properties: domains",
      "source": {
        "pointer": "/domains"
      }
    }
  ],
  "messages": [],
  "result": null,
  "success": false
}
```

> 503 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 10000,
      "message": "Internal API failure for domain example.com",
      "source": {
        "pointer": "/domains/0"
      }
    },
    {
      "code": 10000,
      "message": "Internal API failure for domain mybrand.net",
      "source": {
        "pointer": "/domains/1"
      }
    }
  ],
  "messages": [],
  "result": null,
  "success": false
}
```

<h3 id="check-domain-transfer-eligibility-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successfully returned transfer eligibility results.<br>Each requested domain appears in `result.domains` keyed by domain<br>name. A domain result includes `name`, `transferable`, and `reasons`.<br>|[registrar-api_domain_transfer_check_response](#schemaregistrar-api_domain_transfer_check_response)|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid request body.<br>Common causes include:<br>- Missing `domains` array.<br>- Empty `domains` array.<br>- More than 10 domains in one request.<br>- Missing `domain_name` in a domain object.<br>- Duplicate domain names in the request list.<br>- Unexpected properties in the payload.<br>|[registrar-api_api-response-common-failure](#schemaregistrar-api_api-response-common-failure)|
|503|Service Unavailable|Transfer checks failed for all requested domains due to internal<br>upstream errors.<br>|[registrar-api_api-response-common-failure](#schemaregistrar-api_api-response-common-failure)|

</aside>

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/registrar-sandbox/extensions`

Returns metadata and JSON Schema documents describing the expected input
structure for registration and transfer operations on each supported
extension (TLD).

This endpoint uses cursor-based pagination. Results are ordered by
extension name by default. To fetch the next page, pass the `cursor`
value from the `result_info` object in the response as the `cursor`
query parameter in your next request. An empty `cursor` string
indicates there are no more pages.

Supports HTTP conditional GET via `ETag`. Include the `ETag` value
from a previous response in an `If-None-Match` header to receive a
`304 Not Modified` when the data has not changed.


<h3 id="list-extensions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[registrar-api-sandbox_identifier](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_identifier)|true|none|
|name|query|string|false|Filter extensions by exact name match.<br>For example, `name=com` returns only the `com` extension.<br>|
|cursor|query|string|false|Opaque token from a previous response's `result_info.cursor`.<br>Pass this value to fetch the next page of results. Omit (or<br>pass an empty string) for the first page.<br>|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to return per page.|
|direction|query|string|false|Sort direction for results. Defaults to ascending order.<br>|
|sort_by|query|string|false|Column to sort results by. Defaults to `name` when omitted.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|sort_by|name|
|sort_by|created_at|
|sort_by|updated_at|

## Create Registration

<a id="opIdsandbox-registrar-domain-registration-create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/registrar-sandbox/registrations \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "auto_renew": false,
    "contact_extensions": {
      "ca_legal_type": "CCT"
    },
    "contacts": {
      "registrant": {
        "email": "ada@example.ca",
        "phone": "+1.6135550100",
        "postal_info": {
          "address": {
            "city": "Ottawa",
            "country_code": "CA",
            "postal_code": "K1A 0B1",
            "state": true,
            "street": "123 Queen St"
          },
          "name": "Ada Lovelace",
          "organization": "Example Canada Inc"
        }
      }
    },
    "domain_name": "my-brand-example.ca",
    "years": 1
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/registrar-sandbox/registrations`

Starts a domain registration workflow.

### Prerequisites
- The account must not already be at the maximum supported domain limit.
    A single account may own up to 500 domains in total across registrations
    created through either the dashboard or this API.
- The domain must be on a supported extension for programmatic registration.
- Use `POST /domain-check` immediately before calling this endpoint to confirm
    real-time availability and pricing.

### Defaults
- `years`: defaults to the extension's minimum registration period (1 year for
    most extensions, but varies — for example, `.ai` (if supported) requires a minimum of 2 years).
- `auto_renew`: defaults to `false`. Setting it to `true` is an explicit
    opt-in authorizing Cloudflare to charge the account's default payment
    method up to 30 days before domain expiry to renew the registration.
    Renewal pricing may change over time based on registry pricing.
- `privacy_mode`: defaults to `redaction`.

### Premium domains
Premium domain registration is not currently supported by this API.
If `POST /domain-check` returns `tier: premium`, do not call this
endpoint for that domain.

### Response behavior
By default, the server holds the connection for a bounded, server-defined
amount of time while the registration completes. Most registrations finish
within this window and return `201 Created` with a completed workflow status.

If the registration is still processing after this synchronous wait window,
the server returns `202 Accepted`. Poll the URL in `links.self` to track progress.

To skip the wait and receive an immediate `202`, send `Prefer: respond-async`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "auto_renew": false,
  "contact_extensions": {
    "ca_legal_type": "CCT"
  },
  "contacts": {
    "registrant": {
      "email": "ada@example.ca",
      "phone": "+1.6135550100",
      "postal_info": {
        "address": {
          "city": "Ottawa",
          "country_code": "CA",
          "postal_code": "K1A 0B1",
          "state": true,
          "street": "123 Queen St"
        },
        "name": "Ada Lovelace",
        "organization": "Example Canada Inc"
      }
    }
  },
  "domain_name": "my-brand-example.ca",
  "years": 1
}
```

<h3 id="create-registration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[registrar-api-sandbox_identifier](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_identifier)|true|Cloudflare account ID. Required for all Registrar API operations.|
|Prefer|header|string|false|Set to `respond-async` to receive an immediate `202 Accepted` without<br>waiting for the operation to complete (RFC 7240).<br><br>The header may be combined with other preferences using standard<br>comma-separated syntax.<br>|
|body|body|[registrar-api-sandbox_registration_create_request](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_registration_create_request)|true|none|
|» acknowledgements|body|object|false|Provides user acknowledgements for a specific extension or premium<br>registration flow. The extension registration schema from the<br>extension discovery endpoint identifies the required keys.<br>|
|» auto_renew|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable automatic renewal. Defaults to `false` if omitted.<br>Setting this field to `true` is an explicit opt-in authorizing<br>Cloudflare to charge the account's default payment method up to 30<br>days before domain expiry to renew the domain automatically.<br>Renewal pricing may change over time based on registry pricing.<br>|
|» contact_extensions|body|object|false|Provides registry-specific contact extension values for the registrant.<br>`GET /accounts/{account_id}/registrar/extensions/{extension}` identifies<br>the required keys and allowed values for each extension in the<br>`registration_schema.properties.contact_extensions` object.<br><br>Examples include `.us` nexus fields, `.uk` registrant type fields,<br>and `.ca` legal type fields. Omit this object when the extension's<br>registration schema excludes `contact_extensions`.<br>|
|» contacts|body|object|false|none|
|» » administrator|body|object|false|Optional administrator contact. Accepted only when the extension<br>schema includes this role. When the registry requires an omitted<br>contact, Cloudflare may derive it from `contacts.registrant`.<br>|
|» » » email|body|string(email)|true|Email address for the registrant. Used for domain-related<br>communications from the registry, including ownership verification<br>and renewal notices.<br>|
|» » » fax|body|string|false|Fax number in E.164 format (e.g., `+1.5555555555`). Optional.<br>Most registrations do not require a fax number.<br>|

## Update Registration

<a id="opIdsandbox-registrar-domain-registration-update"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/registrar-sandbox/registrations/example.com \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "auto_renew": false
  }'
```

`PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/registrar-sandbox/registrations/{domain_name}`

Updates an existing domain registration.

By default, the server holds the connection for a bounded, server-defined
amount of time while the update completes. Most updates finish within this
window and return `200 OK` with a completed workflow status.

If the update is still processing after this synchronous wait window, the
server returns `202 Accepted`. Poll the URL in `links.self` to track progress.

To skip the wait and receive an immediate `202`, send `Prefer: respond-async`.

This endpoint currently supports updating `auto_renew` only.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "auto_renew": false
}
```

<h3 id="update-registration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[registrar-api-sandbox_identifier](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_identifier)|true|Cloudflare account ID.|
|domain_name|path|[registrar-api-sandbox_domain_name](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_domain_name)|true|Domain name to update.|
|Prefer|header|string|false|Set to `respond-async` to receive an immediate `202 Accepted` without<br>waiting for the operation to complete (RFC 7240).<br>|
|body|body|[registrar-api-sandbox_registration_update_request](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_registration_update_request)|true|none|
|» auto_renew|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable automatic renewal.<br>Setting this field to `true` authorizes Cloudflare to charge the<br>account's default payment method up to 30 days before domain expiry<br>to renew the domain automatically. Renewal pricing may change over<br>time based on registry pricing.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Prefer|respond-async|

```json
      "resource": "/accounts/abc/registrar/registrations/example.com",

    },
```

## Get Registration Status

<a id="opIdsandbox-registrar-domain-registration-get-status"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/registrar-sandbox/registrations/example.com/registration-status \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/registrar-sandbox/registrations/{domain_name}/registration-status`

Returns the current status of a domain registration workflow.

Use this endpoint to poll for completion when the POST response
returned `202 Accepted`. The URL is provided in the `links.self`
field of the workflow status response.

Poll this endpoint until the workflow reaches a terminal state or a
state that requires user attention.

**Terminal states:** `succeeded` and `failed` are terminal and always
have `completed: true`.

**Non-terminal states:**
- `action_required` has `completed: false` and will not resolve on its
  own. The workflow is paused pending user intervention.
- `blocked` has `completed: false` and indicates the workflow is waiting
  on a third party such as the extension registry or losing registrar.
  Continue polling while informing the user of the delay.

Use increasing backoff between polls. When `state: blocked`, use a
longer polling interval and do not poll indefinitely.

A naive polling loop that only checks `completed` can run indefinitely
when `state: action_required`. Break explicitly on `action_required`:

```js
let status;
do {
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000));
  status = await cloudflare.request({
    method: 'GET',
    path: reg.result.links.self,
  });
} while (
  !status.result.completed &&
  status.result.state !== 'action_required'
);

if (status.result.state === 'action_required') {
  // Surface context.action and context.confirmation_sent_to to the user.
  // Do not re-submit the registration request.
}
```


<h3 id="get-registration-status-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[registrar-api-sandbox_identifier](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_identifier)|true|Cloudflare account ID. Required for all Registrar API operations.|
|domain_name|path|[registrar-api-sandbox_domain_name](#schemaregistrar-api-sandbox_domain_name)|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json

  "errors": [],
  "messages": [],
  "result": {
    "completed": false,
    "context": {
      "action": "registrant_email_confirmation_pending",
      "confirmation_sent_to": "a***@example.com",
      "domain_name": "example.com"
    },
    "created_at": "2025-10-27T10:00:00Z",
    "links": {
      "resource": "/accounts/abc/registrar/registrations/example.com",
      "self": "/accounts/abc/registrar/registrations/example.com/registration-status"
    },
    "state": "action_required",
    "updated_at": "2025-10-27T10:01:00Z"
  },
  "success": true
}
```

> 4XX Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 10000,
      "message": "No workflow found for example.com"
    }
  ],
  "messages": [],
  "result": null,
  "success": false
}
```

## List Registrations

<a id="opIdregistrar-domain-registration-list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/registrar/registrations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/registrar/registrations`

Returns a paginated list of domain registrations owned by the account.

This endpoint uses cursor-based pagination. Results are ordered by registration
date by default. To fetch the next page, pass the `cursor` value from the
`result_info` object in the response as the `cursor` query parameter in
your next request. An empty `cursor` string indicates there are no more
pages.


<h3 id="list-registrations-2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[registrar-api_identifier](#schemaregistrar-api_identifier)|true|Cloudflare account ID.|
|cursor|query|string|false|Opaque token from a previous response's `result_info.cursor`.<br>Pass this value to fetch the next page of results. Omit (or<br>pass an empty string) for the first page.<br>|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to return per page.|
|direction|query|string|false|Sort direction for results. Defaults to ascending order.<br>|
|sort_by|query|string|false|Column to sort results by. Defaults to registration date (`registry_created_at`) when omitted.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|sort_by|registry_created_at|
|sort_by|registry_expires_at|
|sort_by|name|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [],
  "messages": [],
  "result": [],
  "result_info": {
    "count": 0,
    "cursor": "",
    "per_page": 20
  },
  "success": true
}
```

> 4XX Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 10000,
      "message": "Invalid pagination cursor"
    }
  ],
  "messages": [],
  "result": null,
  "success": false
}
```

<h3 id="list-registrations-2-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

## Create Registration

<a id="opIdregistrar-domain-registration-create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/registrar/registrations \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "auto_renew": false,
    "contact_extensions": {
      "ca_legal_type": "CCT"
    },
    "contacts": {
      "registrant": {
        "email": "ada@example.ca",
        "phone": "+1.6135550100",
        "postal_info": {
          "address": {
            "city": "Ottawa",
            "country_code": "CA",
            "postal_code": "K1A 0B1",
            "state": true,
            "street": "123 Queen St"
          },
          "name": "Ada Lovelace",
          "organization": "Example Canada Inc"
        }
      }
    },
    "domain_name": "my-brand-example.ca",
    "years": 1
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/registrar/registrations`

Starts a domain registration workflow. This is a billable operation — successful
registration charges the account's default payment method. All successful
domain registrations are non-refundable — once the workflow completes with
`state: succeeded`, the charge cannot be reversed.

### Prerequisites
- The account must have a billing profile with a valid default payment method.
  Set this up at `https://dash.cloudflare.com/{account_id}/billing/payment-info`.
- The account must not already be at the maximum supported domain limit.
  A single account may own up to 500 domains in total across registrations
  created through either the dashboard or this API.
- The domain must be on a supported extension for programmatic registration.
- Use `POST /domain-check` immediately before calling this endpoint to confirm
  real-time availability and pricing.

### Supported extensions

This API supports programmatic registration for all extensions supported by
the dashboard experience, with the following exceptions:

`giving`, `mom`, `inc`, `lol`, `sh`, `link`, `cc`, `new`

Cloudflare Registrar supports 400+ extensions in the dashboard. Extensions
listed above can be registered at
`https://dash.cloudflare.com/{account_id}/domains/registrations`.

### Express mode
The only required field is `domain_name`. If `contacts` is omitted, the system
uses the account's default address book entry as the registrant. If no default
exists and no contact is provided, the request fails. Set up a default address
book entry and accept the required agreement at
`https://dash.cloudflare.com/{account_id}/domains/registrations`.

### Defaults
- `years`: defaults to the extension's minimum registration period (1 year for
  most extensions, but varies — for example, `.ai` (if supported) requires a minimum of 2 years).
- `auto_renew`: defaults to `false`. Setting it to `true` is an explicit
  opt-in authorizing Cloudflare to charge the account's default payment
  method up to 30 days before domain expiry to renew the registration.
  Renewal pricing may change over time based on registry pricing.
- `privacy_mode`: defaults to `redaction`.

### Premium domains
Premium domain registration is not currently supported by this API.
If `POST /domain-check` returns `tier: premium`, do not call this
endpoint for that domain.

### Response behavior
By default, the server holds the connection for a bounded, server-defined
amount of time while the registration completes. Most registrations finish
within this window and return `201 Created` with a completed workflow status.

If the registration is still processing after this synchronous wait window,
the server returns `202 Accepted`. Poll the URL in `links.self` to track progress.

To skip the wait and receive an immediate `202`, send `Prefer: respond-async`.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "auto_renew": false,
  "contact_extensions": {
    "ca_legal_type": "CCT"
  },
  "contacts": {
    "registrant": {
      "email": "ada@example.ca",
      "phone": "+1.6135550100",
      "postal_info": {
        "address": {
          "city": "Ottawa",
          "country_code": "CA",
          "postal_code": "K1A 0B1",
          "state": true,
          "street": "123 Queen St"
        },
        "name": "Ada Lovelace",
        "organization": "Example Canada Inc"
      }
    }
  },
  "domain_name": "my-brand-example.ca",
  "years": 1
}
```

`PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/registrar/registrations/{domain_name}`

By default, the server holds the connection for a bounded, server-defined

If the update is still processing after this synchronous wait window, the
server returns `202 Accepted`. Poll the URL in `links.self` to track progress.

To skip the wait and receive an immediate `202`, send `Prefer: respond-async`.

This endpoint currently supports updating `auto_renew` only.

## Get Registration Status

<a id="opIdregistrar-domain-registration-get-status"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/registrar/registrations/example.com/registration-status \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/registrar/registrations/{domain_name}/registration-status`

Returns the current status of a domain registration workflow.

Use this endpoint to poll for completion when the POST response
returned `202 Accepted`. The URL is provided in the `links.self`
field of the workflow status response.

Poll this endpoint until the workflow reaches a terminal state or a
state that requires user attention.

**Terminal states:** `succeeded` and `failed` are terminal and always
have `completed: true`.

**Non-terminal states:**
- `action_required` has `completed: false` and will not resolve on its
  own. The workflow is paused pending user intervention.
- `blocked` has `completed: false` and indicates the workflow is waiting
  on a third party such as the extension registry or losing registrar.
  Continue polling while informing the user of the delay.

Use increasing backoff between polls. When `state: blocked`, use a
longer polling interval and do not poll indefinitely.

A naive polling loop that only checks `completed` can run indefinitely
when `state: action_required`. Break explicitly on `action_required`:

```js
let status;
do {
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000));
  status = await cloudflare.request({
    method: 'GET',
    path: reg.result.links.self,
  });
} while (
  !status.result.completed &&
  status.result.state !== 'action_required'
);

if (status.result.state === 'action_required') {
  // Surface context.action and context.confirmation_sent_to to the user.
  // Do not re-submit the registration request.
}
```


<h3 id="get-registration-status-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[registrar-api_identifier](#schemaregistrar-api_identifier)|true|Cloudflare account ID. Required for all Registrar API operations.|
|domain_name|path|[registrar-api_domain_name](#schemaregistrar-api_domain_name)|true|none|

```json
    },

      "resource": "/accounts/abc/registrar/registrations/example.com",
```

## Get Update Status

<a id="opIdregistrar-domain-registration-get-update-status"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/registrar/registrations/{domain_name}/update-status`

Returns the current status of a domain update workflow.

Use this endpoint to poll for completion when the PATCH response
returned `202 Accepted`. The URL is provided in the `links.self`
field of the workflow status response.

Poll this endpoint until the workflow reaches a terminal state or a
state that requires user attention.

Use increasing backoff between polls. When the workflow remains blocked
on a third party, use a longer polling interval and do not poll indefinitely.

|domain_name|path|[registrar-api_domain_name](#schemaregistrar-api_domain_name)|true|none|

<h1 id="cloudflare-api-registrar-transfer">Registrar Transfer</h1>

## Initiate Transfer

<a id="opIdregistrar-domain-transfer-in-create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/registrar/registrations/example.com/transfer-in \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "auth_code": "bml4b3M+Pj5hcmNoLWxpbnV4"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/registrar/registrations/{domain_name}/transfer-in`

Starts a domain transfer-in workflow. This is typically a billable
operation — successful transfers charge the account's default payment
method, except for extensions with zero transfer pricing (e.g. UK
extensions). All successful domain transfers are non-refundable.

### How transfers work
Domain transfers move a domain from another registrar to Cloudflare.
Transfers typically take 1-10 days due to ICANN-mandated approval windows.

### Prerequisites
- The domain must already have a zone in the Cloudflare account (added
  through the dashboard or zone API).
- The zone must have DNSSec disabled.
- For billable transfers (i.e. extensions with non-zero transfer pricing), the
  account must have a billing profile with a valid default payment method.
  Set this up at `https://dash.cloudflare.com/{account_id}/billing/payment-info`.
- The domain must be unlocked at the current registrar.
- An authorization/EPP code from the current registrar is required,
  except for UK extensions — see Auth code below.

### Auth code
An authorization code (also called EPP code, transfer key, or auth-info code)
is required for most extensions, with the exception of UK extensions. Obtain
this from your current registrar's control panel.

The auth code in the request body must be base64-encoded per RFC 4648 §4 (standard
alphabet, no line breaks).

### Response behavior
Successful transfer initiation returns `202 Accepted`. Validation or
initiation failures return the documented `4XX` responses. Poll
`GET /accounts/{account_id}/registrar/registrations/{domain_name}/transfer-in-status` to track progress.

### Premium domains
Premium domain transfers are not currently supported by this API. Please use
the [dashboard](https://dash.cloudflare.com/) for now.

### Billing
The account's default payment method is charged upon successful transfer
completion, unless the extension has zero transfer pricing (e.g. UK
extensions). The transfer adds time to the domain's existing expiration
date (typically 1 year).


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "auth_code": "bml4b3M+Pj5hcmNoLWxpbnV4"
}
```

## Get Transfer Status

<a id="opIdregistrar-domain-transfer-get-status"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/registrar/registrations/example.com/transfer-in-status \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/registrar/registrations/{domain_name}/transfer-in-status`

Returns the current status of a domain transfer workflow.

Use this endpoint to poll transfer progress after initiating a transfer
with `POST /accounts/{account_id}/registrar/registrations/{domain_name}/transfer-in`.
The URL is provided in the `links.self` field of the transfer response.

### Transfer timelines
Transfers typically take 1–10 days due to ICANN-mandated approval windows.

### Workflow states

**Terminal states:** `succeeded` and `failed` are terminal and always
have `completed: true`.

**Non-terminal states:**
- `in_progress`: Transfer has been submitted to the registry and is being
  processed. Continue polling.
- `blocked`: The workflow is waiting on the losing registrar or registry
  to release the domain. This is the **most common state** for transfers
  and is entirely normal — it means the ICANN transfer approval window is
  in effect. The losing registrar has up to 5 days to approve or reject.
  Continue polling with longer intervals (e.g., every 30–60 minutes).
- `action_required`: The user needs to take action (e.g., the FOA email
  needs to be accepted). See `context` for details on what is needed.
- `pending`: Transfer workflow created but not yet started processing.

### Polling guidance
Adjust your polling interval based on the current workflow state:
- `pending` or `in_progress`: Poll every 30 seconds.
- `blocked`: The transfer is waiting on a third party (e.g., losing
  registrar approval). Poll every 30–60 minutes.
- `action_required`: Stop polling. The workflow will not advance until
  the user takes action. Check `context` for details on what is needed.
- `succeeded` or `failed`: Terminal — stop polling.

|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[registrar-api_identifier](#schemaregistrar-api_identifier)|true|Cloudflare account ID. Required for all Registrar API operations.|
|domain_name|path|[registrar-api_domain_name](#schemaregistrar-api_domain_name)|true|none|

```json
    },

    "updated_at": "2025-10-27T12:00:00Z"
  },
  "success": true
}
```


<h3 id="get-transfer-status-responses">Responses</h3>

<h1 id="cloudflare-api-account-request-tracer">Account Request Tracer</h1>

## Request Trace

<a id="opIdaccount-request-tracer-request-trace"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/request-tracer/trace \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "body": {
      "base64": "c29tZV9yZXF1ZXN0X2JvZHk="
    },
    "context": {
      "geoloc": {
        "city": "London"
      },
      "skip_challenge": true
    },
    "cookies": {
      "cookie_name_1": "cookie_value_1",
      "cookie_name_2": "cookie_value_2"
    },
    "headers": {
      "header_name_1": "header_value_1",
      "header_name_2": "header_value_2"
    },
    "method": "PUT",
    "protocol": "HTTP/1.1",
    "url": "https://some.zone/some_path"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/request-tracer/trace`

Traces a simulated HTTP request through Cloudflare's edge to analyze how rules, settings, and configurations would process the request. Useful for debugging firewall rules, page rules, and other request transformations without sending actual traffic. Supports custom headers, cookies, body content, and geolocation context.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "body": {
    "base64": "c29tZV9yZXF1ZXN0X2JvZHk="
  },
  "context": {
    "geoloc": {
      "city": "London"
    },
    "skip_challenge": true
  },
  "cookies": {
    "cookie_name_1": "cookie_value_1",
    "cookie_name_2": "cookie_value_2"
  },
  "headers": {
    "header_name_1": "header_value_1",
    "header_name_2": "header_value_2"
  },
  "method": "PUT",
  "protocol": "HTTP/1.1",
  "url": "https://some.zone/some_path"
}
```

## List SCIM Groups

<a id="opIdscim-groups-list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Groups' \
  -H 'Accept: application/scim+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Groups`

Lists SCIM Group resources for the account. Returns both system groups (backed by Cloudflare permission groups, prefixed `cloudflare-v1-`) and custom user groups. Supports filtering by `displayName` using SCIM filter syntax.


<h3 id="list-scim-groups-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[iam_account_identifier](#schemaiam_account_identifier)|true|none|
|startIndex|query|integer|false|none|
|count|query|integer|false|none|
|filter|query|string|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Resources": [
    {
```

## Replace SCIM Group

<a id="opIdscim-groups-put"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Groups/cloudflare-v1-023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353' \
  -X PUT \

  -d '{

    "externalId": "idp-group-456",
    "members": [
      {
        "value": "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
      }
    ],
    "schemas": [
      "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Groups/{group_id}`

Replaces the mutable attributes of a SCIM Group (RFC 7644 Section 3.5.1), including its complete member set. Omitting `externalId` clears it, and omitting `members` replaces the member set with an empty list. For system groups (prefixed `cloudflare-v1-`), only the member set is replaced.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "displayName": "My IdP Group",
  "externalId": "idp-group-456",
  "members": [
    {
      "value": "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
    }
  ],
  "schemas": [
    "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="replace-scim-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[iam_account_identifier](#schemaiam_account_identifier)|true|none|
|group_id|path|[iam_scim_group_identifier](#schemaiam_scim_group_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|[iam_scim_group_replace_request](#schemaiam_scim_group_replace_request)|true|none|
|» displayName|body|string|true|A human-readable name for the Group.|
|» externalId|body|string|false|Identifier for the Group as defined by the provisioning client (IdP). Omission clears the existing value.<br>|
|» members|body|[[iam_scim_group_patch_member_value](#schemaiam_scim_group_patch_member_value)]|false|The complete replacement member set. Omission is treated as an empty list.<br>|
|» schemas|body|[string]|true|Must contain `urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group`.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "displayName": "Administrators",
  "externalId": "idp-group-456",
  "id": "cloudflare-v1-023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353",
  "members": [
    {
      "display": "user@example.com",
      "value": "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "resourceType": "Group"
  },
  "schemas": [
    "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"
  ]
}
```

> 4XX Response

```json
{
  "detail": "Invalid SCIM request: userName is required",
  "schemas": [
    "urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:Error"
  ],
  "scimType": "uniqueness",
  "status": "400"
}
```

`GET /accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Users`

Lists account members as SCIM User resources. Supports optional filtering by `userName` (email) using the SCIM filter syntax (e.g. `userName eq "user@example.com"`). Pagination is controlled via `startIndex` and `count` query parameters per RFC 7644 Section 3.4.2.4.

## Create SCIM User

<a id="opIdscim-users-create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Users' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/scim+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/scim+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "active": true,
    "displayName": "Jane Smith",
    "emails": [
      {
        "primary": true,
        "type": "work",
        "value": "user@example.com"
      }
    ],
    "externalId": "idp-user-abc123",
    "name": {
      "familyName": "Smith",
      "givenName": "Jane"
    },
    "schemas": [
      "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"
    ],
    "userName": "user@example.com"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Users`

Provisions a new account member via SCIM. The `userName` field must be a valid email address and must match the primary email in `emails`. The account must be an Enterprise account with SCIM entitlements enabled.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "active": true,
  "displayName": "Jane Smith",
  "emails": [
    {
      "primary": true,
      "type": "work",
      "value": "user@example.com"
    }
  ],
  "externalId": "idp-user-abc123",
  "name": {
    "familyName": "Smith",
    "givenName": "Jane"
  },
  "schemas": [
    "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"
  ],
  "userName": "user@example.com"
}
```

<h3 id="create-scim-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[iam_account_identifier](#schemaiam_account_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|[iam_scim_user_create_request](#schemaiam_scim_user_create_request)|true|none|
|» active|body|boolean|true|A Boolean value indicating the user's administrative status. Must be `true` for user creation.|
|» displayName|body|string|false|The name of the user, suitable for display to end-users. If not explicitly set, falls back to the formatted name or userName.|
|» emails|body|[[iam_scim_user_email_object](#schemaiam_scim_user_email_object)]|true|Email addresses for the user. The primary email must match `userName`.|
|» externalId|body|string|false|An identifier for the user as defined by the provisioning client (IdP). This value is stored and returned but not interpreted by Cloudflare.|
|» name|body|[iam_scim_user_name_object](#schemaiam_scim_user_name_object)|false|The components of the user's real name.|
|» schemas|body|[string]|true|Must contain `urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User`.|
|» userName|body|string(email)|true|Unique identifier for the user, equal to the user's email address.|

```json
    "cloudflare-v1-023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
  ],
  "id": "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353",
  "meta": {
```

`PUT /accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Users/{user_id}`

Replaces a SCIM User resource (RFC 7644 Section 3.5.1). Fully replaces the mutable attributes of the user. Supports updating `userName`, `name`, `emails`, and `active`.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "active": true,
  "displayName": "Jane Smith",
  "emails": [

    }
```

|body|body|[iam_scim_user_replace_request](#schemaiam_scim_user_replace_request)|true|none|

|» emails|body|[[iam_scim_user_email_object](#schemaiam_scim_user_email_object)]|false|Email addresses for the user. If a primary email is provided, it must match `userName`.|
|» externalId|body|string|false|An identifier for the user as defined by the provisioning client (IdP). This value is stored and returned but not interpreted by Cloudflare.|

|» schemas|body|[string]|true|Must contain `urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User`.|
|» userName|body|string(email)|true|Unique identifier for the user, equal to the user's email address.|

`PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Users/{user_id}`

Partially updates a SCIM User via PATCH operations (RFC 7644 Section 3.5.2). Supports updating `userName`, `name.givenName`, `name.familyName`, and `active`. ## Delete a store

<a id="opIdsecrets-store-delete-by-id"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/985e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/secrets_store/stores/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Auth-Email: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "X-Auth-Key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/secrets_store/stores/{store_id}`

Deletes a single store. By default, a store that still contains secrets
cannot be deleted and returns HTTP 409 (Conflict) with the "store_not_empty"
error. Pass `force=true` to cascade-delete all secrets in the store.
Empty stores are always deleted regardless of the force parameter.


<h3 id="delete-a-store-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|Account identifier.|
|store_id|path|string|true|Store identifier.|
|force|query|boolean|false|When true, cascade-deletes all secrets in the store before deleting the store itself.<br>Required when deleting a non-empty store. Without this parameter, attempting to<br>delete a non-empty store returns 409.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [],
  "messages": [],
  "success": true,
  "result": {}
}
```

> 409 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 7003,
      "message": "No route for the URI"
    }
  ],
  "messages": [],
  "result": null,
  "success": false
}
```

> 4XX Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 7003,
      "message": "No route for the URI"
    }
  ],
  "messages": [],
  "result": null,
  "success": false
}
```

<h3 id="delete-a-store-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Store deleted.|[secrets-store_delete_response](#schemasecrets-store_delete_response)|

## Trigger a share rename

<a id="opIdshare-update"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/shares/3fd85f74b32742f1bff64a85009dda07 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Auth-Email: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "X-Auth-Key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "My Shared WAF Managed Rule"
  }'
```

`PUT /accounts/{account_id}/shares/{share_id}`

Updates the share's display name and tags. This endpoint does **not**
modify recipients or resources — those are managed via dedicated
subresource endpoints:

- **Recipients**: Use `POST /accounts/{account_id}/shares/{share_id}/recipients`
  to add a single recipient, `PUT /accounts/{account_id}/shares/{share_id}/recipients`
  to replace the full recipient list, or
  `DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/shares/{share_id}/recipients/{recipient_id}`
  to remove a recipient.
- **Resources**: Use the share's resource subresource endpoints.

Updating is not immediate; an updated share object with a new status
will be returned.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "My Shared WAF Managed Rule"
}
```

<h3 id="trigger-a-share-rename-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|share_id|path|[resource-sharing_share_id](#schemaresource-sharing_share_id)|true|none|
|body|body|[resource-sharing_update_share_request](#schemaresource-sharing_update_share_request)|true|none|
|» name|body|[resource-sharing_share_name](#schemaresource-sharing_share_name)|true|The name of the share.|

## Trigger recipient reconciliation on a share

<a id="opIdshare-recipients-update"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/shares/3fd85f74b32742f1bff64a85009dda07/recipients \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Auth-Email: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "X-Auth-Key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '[
    {
      "account_id": {},
      "organization_id": "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353",
      "recipient_account_id": {}
    }
  ]'
```

`PUT /accounts/{account_id}/shares/{share_id}/recipients`

Replaces the full recipient list for an account-targeted share. The
server computes the diff between the current and desired recipients:
new accounts are added, accounts no longer in the list are marked for
disassociation, and unchanged accounts are left as-is.

Returns an error if the share targets an organization
(`target_type=organization`); org-targeted shares derive their
recipients dynamically from org membership and cannot be modified
through this endpoint.


> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "account_id": {},
    "organization_id": "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353",
    "recipient_account_id": {}
  }
]
```

<h3 id="trigger-recipient-reconciliation-on-a-share-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[resource-sharing_account_id](#schemaresource-sharing_account_id)|true|none|
|share_id|path|[resource-sharing_share_id](#schemaresource-sharing_share_id)|true|none|
|body|body|[resource-sharing_update_share_recipients_request](#schemaresource-sharing_update_share_recipients_request)|true|none|

Adds a single recipient to an account-targeted resource share, granting
them access to the shared resources. The recipient account must belong
to the same organization as the share owner.

To replace the entire recipient list in one call, use
`PUT /accounts/{account_id}/shares/{share_id}/recipients` instead.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "account_id": {},
  "organization_id": "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353",
  "recipient_account_id": {}
}
```

|» account_id|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Deprecated alias for `recipient_account_id`. Use `recipient_account_id` instead.<br>The body field collided with the URL path parameter of the same name, which prevented SDK generators from distinguishing the source account (in the URL) from the recipient account (in the body). Both names will continue to be accepted until 2027-05-26 (see `x-sunset`).<br>|

## Trigger a recipient removal from a share

<a id="opIdshare-recipient-delete"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/shares/3fd85f74b32742f1bff64a85009dda07/recipients/3fd85f74b32742f1bff64a85009dda07 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Auth-Email: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H "X-Auth-Key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/shares/{share_id}/recipients/{recipient_id}`

Performs a **soft delete**: sets the recipient's
`desired_association_status` to `disassociated`, which signals the
background reconciliation workflow (Temporal) to remove the shared
resources from the recipient account. The recipient record remains in
the database for audit purposes and is still returned by
`GET /accounts/{account_id}/shares/{share_id}/recipients` with its
updated status.

Resource access is not fully removed until the workflow completes and
`current_association_status` transitions to `disassociated`. The
recipient record itself is never physically deleted.


<h3 id="trigger-a-recipient-removal-from-a-share-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[resource-sharing_account_id](#schemaresource-sharing_account_id)|true|none|
|share_id|path|[resource-sharing_share_id](#schemaresource-sharing_share_id)|true|none|
|recipient_id|path|[resource-sharing_recipient_id](#schemaresource-sharing_recipient_id)|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [],
  "success": true,

    "account_id": "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353",

    "created": "2023-09-21T18:56:32.624632Z",
```

## Create a namespace

<a id="opIdworkers-kv-namespace-create-a-namespace"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/storage/kv/namespaces \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "jurisdiction": "eu",
    "mode": "instant",
    "title": "My Own Namespace"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces`

Creates a Workers KV namespace in the specified account with the given title. Returns `400` if the account already owns a namespace with that title; an existing namespace must be explicitly deleted before it can be replaced. An optional jurisdiction restricts where data is durably stored and can only be set at creation time.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "jurisdiction": "eu",
  "mode": "instant",
  "title": "My Own Namespace"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-namespace-3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|[workers-kv_identifier](#schemaworkers-kv_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|[workers-kv_create_namespace_body](#schemaworkers-kv_create_namespace_body)|true|none|
|» jurisdiction|body|[workers-kv_jurisdiction](#schemaworkers-kv_jurisdiction)|false|Specify the jurisdiction to restrict the KV namespace to durably store data within. Can only be set at namespace creation time.|
|» mode|body|string|false|The mode of the Workers KV namespace. Specify `instant` when creating a namespace to create a KV Instant namespace. Omit this field when creating a namespace to create a classic namespace. Currently, `instant` is the only supported explicit value.|
|» title|body|[workers-kv_namespace_title](#schemaworkers-kv_namespace_title)|true|Human-readable string name for a Workers KV namespace.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» jurisdiction|eu|
|» jurisdiction|fedramp|
|» jurisdiction|us|
|» mode|instant|

## Write multiple key-value pairs

<a id="opIdworkers-kv-namespace-write-multiple-key-value-pairs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/storage/kv/namespaces/0f2ac74b498b48028cb68387c421e279/bulk \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '[
    {
      "base64": false,
      "expiration": 1578435000,
      "expiration_ttl": 300,
      "key": "My-Key",
      "metadata": {
        "someMetadataKey": "someMetadataValue"
      },
      "value": "Some string"
    }
  ]'
```

`PUT /accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/bulk`

Writes up to 10,000 key-value pairs to the specified Workers KV namespace from a JSON array, with optional metadata and expiration settings for each pair. Existing values and expirations are overwritten. If neither `expiration` nor `expiration_ttl` is specified, the key-value pair will not expire. If both are set, `expiration_ttl` takes precedence. The entire request must be 100 megabytes or less. The result reports the number of successful writes and any keys that failed and should be retried.

> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "base64": false,
    "expiration": 1578435000,
    "expiration_ttl": 300,
    "key": "My-Key",
    "metadata": {
      "someMetadataKey": "someMetadataValue"
    },
    "value": "Some string"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="write-multiple-key-value-pairs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace_id|path|[workers-kv_namespace_identifier](#schemaworkers-kv_namespace_identifier)|true|none|
|account_id|path|[workers-kv_identifier](#schemaworkers-kv_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|[workers-kv_bulk_write](#schemaworkers-kv_bulk_write)|true|none|
|» base64|body|boolean|false|Indicates whether or not the server should base64 decode the value before storing it. Useful for writing values that wouldn't otherwise be valid JSON strings, such as images.|
|» expiration|body|[workers-kv_expiration](#schemaworkers-kv_expiration)|false|Expires the key at a certain time, measured in number of seconds since the UNIX epoch.|
|» expiration_ttl|body|[workers-kv_expiration_ttl](#schemaworkers-kv_expiration_ttl)|false|Number of seconds until the key expires. Must be at least 60. Takes precedence over `expiration` when both are specified.|
|» key|body|[workers-kv_key_name_bulk](#schemaworkers-kv_key_name_bulk)|true|A key's name. The name may be at most 512 bytes. All printable, non-whitespace characters are valid.|
|» metadata|body|[workers-kv_list_metadata](#schemaworkers-kv_list_metadata)|false|Arbitrary JSON that is associated with a key.|
|» value|body|string|true|A UTF-8 encoded string to be stored, up to 25 MiB in length.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [],
  "messages": [],
  "success": true,
  "result": {
    "successful_key_count": 100,
    "unsuccessful_keys": [
      "string"
    ]
  }
}
```

> 4XX Response

```json
{
  "errors": [],
  "messages": [],
  "success": true,
  "result": {
    "successful_key_count": 100,
    "unsuccessful_keys": [
      "string"
    ]
  }
}
```

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Write multiple key-value pairs response.|Inline|
|4XX|Client Error|Write multiple key-value pairs response failure.|Inline|

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/bulk/get`

Retrieves the text-based values of up to 100 keys from the specified Workers KV namespace. The result maps each requested key to its value. Set `type` to `json` to parse JSON values instead of returning strings, and set `withMetadata` to `true` to include metadata with each value. Binary values are not supported by this operation.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "keys": [
    "My-Key"
  ],
  "type": "text",
  "withMetadata": false
}
```

|namespace_id|path|[workers-kv_namespace_identifier](#schemaworkers-kv_namespace_identifier)|true|none|
|account_id|path|[workers-kv_identifier](#schemaworkers-kv_identifier)|true|none|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» keys|body|[[workers-kv_key_name_bulk](#schemaworkers-kv_key_name_bulk)]|true|Array of keys to retrieve (maximum of 100).|
|» type|body|string|false|Return values as strings with `text`, or parse stored JSON values with `json`.|
|» withMetadata|body|boolean|false|Whether to include metadata in the response.|

#### Enumerated Values

|» type|json|

```bash
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/storage/kv/namespaces/0f2ac74b498b48028cb68387c421e279/values/My-Key \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F 'metadata={"someMetadataKey":"someMetadataValue"}' \
  -F 'value=Some Value'
```

`PUT /accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/values/{key_name}`

Writes a value under the specified key in the Workers KV namespace, creating the key-value pair or replacing its existing value, expiration, and metadata. Send the value as an `application/octet-stream` request body, or use `multipart/form-data` with a `value` part and an optional JSON `metadata` part. Use URL-encoding for special characters (for example, `:`, `!`, `%`) in the key name when constructing the request URL. If neither `expiration` nor `expiration_ttl` is specified, the key-value pair will not expire. If both are set, `expiration_ttl` takes precedence.

> Body parameter

```yaml
metadata:
  someMetadataKey: someMetadataValue
value: Some Value
```

<h3 id="write-a-key-value-pair-with-optional-metadata-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|key_name|path|[workers-kv_key_name](#schemaworkers-kv_key_name)|true|none|
|namespace_id|path|[workers-kv_namespace_identifier](#schemaworkers-kv_namespace_identifier)|true|none|
|account_id|path|[workers-kv_identifier](#schemaworkers-kv_identifier)|true|none|
|expiration|query|[workers-kv_expiration](#schemaworkers-kv_expiration)|false|none|
|expiration_ttl|query|[workers-kv_expiration_ttl](#schemaworkers-kv_expiration_ttl)|false|none|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» metadata|body|[workers-kv_metadata](#schemaworkers-kv_metadata)|false|Associates arbitrary JSON data with a key/value pair.|
|» value|body|[workers-kv_value](#schemaworkers-kv_value)|true|A byte sequence to be stored, up to 25 MiB in length.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [],
  "messages": [],
  "success": true,
  "result": {}
}
```

> 4XX Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": 7003,
      "message": "No route for the URI"
    }
  ],
  "messages": [],
  "result": {},
  "success": false
}
```

<h3 id="write-a-key-value-pair-with-optional-metadata-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|200|OK|Write key-value pair with metadata response.|[workers-kv_api-response-common-no-result](#schemaworkers-kv_api-response-common-no-result)|
|4XX|Client Error|Write key-value pair with metadata response failure.|[workers-kv_api-response-common-failure](#schemaworkers-kv_api-response-common-failure)|
